items.title_en: An Agent-Driven, Cross-Validated Inverse-Design Pipeline for Dielectric Metasurfaces
items.title_zh: 面向介电超表面的智能体驱动、交叉验证逆向设计流水线
items.abstract_en: Inverse design of dielectric metasurfaces is powerful but labour-intensive: each new target requires choosing a parameterization and a figure of merit, managing compute resources, and critically assessing results that may be numerically unconverged, sensitive to fabrication errors or trapped in local optima. Here we present an open-source pipeline in which an artificial intelligence (AI) coding agent turns a plain-language specification into metasurface optimization runs, executes them, analyses every run with a fixed checklist and proposes the next iteration. Designs are optimized with differentiable three-dimensional rigorous coupled-wave analysis (RCWA), including robustness to fabrication tolerances, and every reported design is independently verified with finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations. We demonstrate the workflow at 1550 nm on a freeform silicon metagrating, on a polarization-independent meta-atom library assembled into beam-deflecting supercells, and on metalenses built from the same library. In the metagrating case, the independent FDTD verification revealed a 5\% overestimate of the efficiency by the optimization model that a conventional convergence test had not detected, and the robust design retained most of its efficiency under $\pm$10~nm fabrication errors. In the other cases, instead, the obtained RCWA results are confirmed by full-wave simulations.
items.abstract_zh: 介电超表面的逆向设计功能强大，但劳动密集：每个新目标都需要选择参数化和品质因数、管理计算资源，并批判性地评估可能数值未收敛、对制造误差敏感或陷入局部最优的结果。在这里，我们提出一个开源流水线，其中人工智能（AI）编码智能体将自然语言规格转换为超表面优化运行，执行这些运行，用固定检查清单分析每次运行，并提出下一次迭代。设计使用可微三维严格耦合波分析（RCWA）进行优化，包括对制造容差的鲁棒性，并且每个报告的设计都用有限差分时域（FDTD）仿真独立验证。我们在 1550 nm 下演示了该工作流：自由形状硅超光栅、组装成偏转光束超胞的偏振无关超原子库，以及由同一库构建的超透镜。在超光栅案例中，独立 FDTD 验证揭示了优化模型对效率高估 5%，而传统收敛测试未检测到这一点；鲁棒设计在 ±10 nm 制造误差下保留了大部分效率。在其他案例中，所获得的 RCWA 结果反而由全波仿真确认。

items.title_en: IMUDINO: Self-distilled Foundation Model for Inertial Sensing
items.title_zh: IMUDINO：用于惯性感知的自蒸馏基础模型
items.abstract_en: We present IMUDINO, the first foundation model (FM) for inertial sensing to achieve competitive performance across diverse sensing tasks including human activity recognition (HAR), health, motion capture, and odometry. Prior inertial FMs often focus on one subfield of inertial sensing and sometimes underperform state-of-the-art supervised methods (e.g., in HAR), making their scope considerably narrower than FMs for vision and natural language. Moreover, they often require fixed input length and sampling rate, and generalize poorly to unseen sensor locations. To build a general-purpose foundation model for inertial sensing, we adapt the DINO self-supervised learning (SSL) paradigm to inertial data through a set of semantics-preserving motion transformations that simulate variations in motion pattern and sensor setup. For model architecture, we use a plain transformer encoder with frequency-aware positional encoding that natively supports varying input length and sampling rate. This simple setup proved remarkably effective for learning global and dense features generalizable across users, sensor setups, tasks, and, in the case of robot odometry, embodiments. We hope IMUDINO can serve as a backbone for inertial sensing and kickstart the development of general-purpose inertial FMs.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 IMUDINO，这是首个在包括人体活动识别（HAR）、健康、动作捕捉和里程计在内的多样感知任务上取得有竞争力性能的惯性感知基础模型（FM）。此前的惯性 FM 往往只关注惯性感知的一个子领域，有时甚至不如最先进的监督方法（例如在 HAR 中），使其范围明显窄于视觉和自然语言 FM。此外，它们通常要求固定的输入长度和采样率，并且对未见的传感器位置泛化较差。为了构建通用的惯性感知基础模型，我们通过一组保持语义的运动变换，将 DINO 自监督学习（SSL）范式适配到惯性数据，这些变换模拟运动模式和传感器设置的变化。在模型架构上，我们使用带有频率感知位置编码的普通 Transformer 编码器，原生支持变化的输入长度和采样率。这种简单设置在学习可跨用户、传感器设置、任务以及（在机器人里程计情况下）具身泛化的全局和稠密特征方面被证明非常有效。我们希望 IMUDINO 能作为惯性感知的骨干，并推动通用惯性 FM 的发展。

items.title_en: The Geometry of Simulated Perspectives: Dissociating Representation and Behaviour in a Multimodal Language Model
items.title_zh: 模拟视角的几何：在多模态语言模型中分离表征与行为
items.abstract_en: Multimodal language models can simulate different observers, yet it remains unclear how assigned perspectives reshape their internal representations and whether these changes govern their judgements. Here, we investigate the representational geometry of persona-conditioned visual interestingness in Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Across 100 images and 53 prompting conditions, we systematically vary persona content and the linguistic framing used to introduce it, while recording behavioural ratings and layer-wise hidden states. We observe a systematic reorganisation of representational geometry across processing depth: early layers primarily encode image identity, whereas persona-specific structures emerge in later layers. Strikingly, prompt framing reshapes internal representations more strongly than persona identity, whereas persona content has a greater impact on behavioural judgements. This dissociation is further illustrated by minimal identity statements that alter representations even without changing responses. These findings demonstrate that representational distance does not necessarily reflect behavioural relevance. More broadly, they reveal how simulated perspectives emerge as distinct structures within the representational space of artificial cognitive systems, highlighting a fundamental distinction between the geometry of internal representations and their functional consequences.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态语言模型可以模拟不同的观察者，但分配给它们的视角如何重塑内部表征，以及这些变化是否支配其判断，仍不清楚。在这里，我们研究 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 中由人格条件引发的视觉趣味性的表征几何。在 100 张图像和 53 种提示条件上，我们系统地改变人格内容以及用于引入该人格的语言框架，同时记录行为评分和逐层隐藏状态。我们观察到表征几何随处理深度发生系统性重组：早期层主要编码图像身份，而人格特定结构在后期层出现。引人注目的是，提示框架比人格身份更强地重塑内部表征，而人格内容对行为判断的影响更大。这种分离进一步由最小身份陈述说明：即使不改变响应，它们也会改变表征。这些发现表明，表征距离不一定反映行为相关性。更广泛地说，它们揭示了模拟视角如何作为独特结构出现在人工认知系统的表征空间中，突出表明内部表征的几何与其功能后果之间存在根本区别。

items.title_en: VFlash: Fast, Accurate Visual Planning via Flash Primitive Decoding
items.title_zh: VFlash：通过 Flash 基元解码实现快速、准确的视觉规划
items.abstract_en: Models for physical AI tasks, such as robotics and autonomous driving, need not reason solely in language. They can use visual plans--points, bounding boxes, and trajectories--to represent spatial goals and anticipate motion. However, autoregressive vision-language models generate these plans one coordinate token at a time, making richer predictions increasingly costly. We introduce VFlash, a method for fast, accurate visual planning through Flash Primitive Decoding. VFlash exploits the known structure of visual primitives to predict their coordinates jointly, using a lightweight drafter that generates an entire primitive in one forward pass. The layout adapts to the primitive's type, dimensionality, and length, supporting compact boxes and long, variable-length trajectories. Crucially, spatial accuracy need not require reproducing an autoregressive model's exact token sequence. VFlash therefore trains on annotated primitives and directly accepts structurally valid predictions without target-token agreement. Across the evaluated 2D and 3D robot trajectory tasks, VFlash consistently reduces prediction errors relative to autoregressive decoding. Preliminary single-rollout measurements indicate approximately 25x faster generation for 3D point motion forecasting. A world action model conditioned on VFlash plans achieves 70.2% average success across four MolmoSpaces task suites, compared with 62.6% for the baseline.
items.abstract_zh: 面向物理 AI 任务（如机器人和自动驾驶）的模型不必仅用语言推理。它们可以使用视觉规划——点、边界框和轨迹——来表示空间目标并预判运动。然而，自回归视觉语言模型一次生成一个坐标 token 来产生这些规划，使得更丰富的预测成本越来越高。我们提出 VFlash，一种通过 Flash 基元解码实现快速、准确视觉规划的方法。VFlash 利用视觉基元的已知结构来联合预测其坐标，使用一个轻量级草稿器在一次前向传播中生成整个基元。其布局适应基元的类型、维度和长度，支持紧凑边界框和长且可变长度的轨迹。关键在于，空间准确性不必要求复现自回归模型的精确 token 序列。因此，VFlash 在标注基元上训练，并直接接受结构有效的预测，而不要求与目标 token 一致。在所评估的 2D 和 3D 机器人轨迹任务中，VFlash 相对自回归解码持续降低预测误差。初步单次 rollout 测量表明，3D 点运动预测的生成速度约快 25 倍。以 VFlash 规划为条件的世界动作模型在四个 MolmoSpaces 任务套件上平均成功率达到 70.2%，而基线为 62.6%。

items.title_en: Structure from Collision via Hypothesis-Space Reasoning
items.title_zh: 基于假设空间推理的碰撞结构反演（Structure from Collision）
items.abstract_en: Knowledge of the hidden interior structure of an object, including the presence and location of cavities, is essential for predictive simulation, robotic manipulation, and nondestructive inspection. However, such cavities leave no direct signature on the static visible surface, making collision-induced deformation one of the few cues used to infer their presence. Structure from Collision (SfC) addresses this problem by recovering the hidden interior structure of an object from multiview observations of a collision event. SfC is challenging for two reasons: hidden cavities are only indirectly observable through surface motion, and voids correspond to the absence of material, making direct optimization using standard density representations difficult. The density-based SfC baseline inherits both difficulties. Surface-matching gradients do not directly indicate the cavity location, while density gradients can be weak or uninformative inside or near void regions. Therefore, we reformulate SfC as hypothesis-space reasoning, representing hidden cavities as explicit structural hypotheses whose variables encode available structural assumptions rather than relying on implicit density updates. A global stage performs gradient-free optimization over this hypothesis space using forward-only material point method (MPM) simulation. A local stage then refines the selected hypothesis as a Lagrangian particle system through gradient-based optimization using differentiable MPM simulation. On the SfC benchmark, our method improves hidden-structure reconstruction and future prediction over the density-based SfC baseline. Interior-topology stress tests and robustness analyses characterize its scope and limitations. The project page is available at https://www.kecl.ntt.co.jp/people/kaneko.takuhiro/projects/sfc-hypothesis/.
items.abstract_zh: 了解物体隐藏的内部结构（包括空腔的有无与位置）对预测性仿真、机器人操作与无损检测至关重要。但空腔不会在静态可见表面上留下直接痕迹，碰撞引起的形变是少数可用线索之一。Structure from Collision（SfC）通过碰撞事件的多视角观测恢复物体隐藏的内部结构。其难点有二：隐藏空腔只能通过表面运动间接观测；空洞意味着材料缺失，使基于标准密度表示的直接优化难以奏效。基于密度的 SfC 基线同时继承这两点困难：表面匹配梯度不直接指示空腔位置，密度梯度在空洞内部或附近可能很弱甚至无信息。因此我们把 SfC 重构为假设空间推理，将隐藏空腔表示为显式结构假设，其变量编码可用的结构先验而非依赖隐式密度更新。全局阶段利用仅前向的物质点法（MPM）模拟在假设空间上做无梯度优化；局部阶段再把所选假设作为拉格朗日粒子系统，借助可微 MPM 进行梯度优化细化。在 SfC 基准上，本方法较密度基线改进了隐藏结构重建与未来预测；内部拓扑压力测试与鲁棒性分析刻画了其适用范围与局限。
items.highlight_zh: 把碰撞反演内部结构重构为假设空间推理，绕开密度梯度困境
items.digest_zh:
• 研究了什么：物体内部有没有空洞、空洞在哪，对仿真、机器人抓取和无损检测都很重要。可空腔在静态表面上完全看不出来，少数可用的线索是“碰撞后表面怎么变形”。Structure from Collision（SfC）就是从碰撞事件的多视角观测反推物体内部隐藏结构。它难在两点：空腔只能通过表面运动间接看到；空洞本质是“没有材料”，用常规的密度场表示很难直接优化——表面匹配的梯度并不指向空腔，而空洞内部和附近的密度梯度又很弱、几乎没信息。
• 用了什么方法：作者不再用密度表示硬优化，而是把 SfC 重写成“假设空间推理”：把隐藏空腔表示成一组显式的结构假设，变量直接编码可用的结构先验（比如腔的数量、位置、大小）。求解分两阶段：全局阶段用仅前向的物质点法（MPM）物理模拟，在假设空间上做无梯度优化来选出候选；局部阶段把选中的假设当作拉格朗日粒子系统，用可微 MPM 做梯度优化进一步细化。
• 有什么结果：在 SfC 基准上，隐藏结构重建和未来形变预测都比基于密度的基线更好。作者还做了内部拓扑压力测试和鲁棒性分析，说明方法在什么情况下有效、在哪些方面有局限。
• 为何重要：它绕开了密度表示在“材料缺失”处的梯度病态，把难以求导的逆问题转化为结构假设的搜索与精修，为从碰撞中“看见”内部结构提供了更可靠的思路。

items.title_en: Ablating Design Choices for Protein Ensemble Generators Across Structural Regimes
items.title_zh: 跨结构状态下蛋白质系综生成器设计选择的消融
items.abstract_en: Generative models of protein conformational ensembles inherit much of their design from structure prediction for folded proteins. Ordered and disordered proteins, however, occupy distinct structural regimes, and we investigate how design choices hold up across them. Using a minimal C$α$ flow-matching model, we ablate choices of architecture, sequence conditioning, rigid-body alignment and training source, and evaluate each variant against experimental SAXS and NMR chemical-shift data partitioned into ordered, disordered, multi-domain and transitional proteins. Mixture-of-experts routing, a static pair representation and a disorder probe have no detectable effect, a smaller protein language model performs worse on ordered proteins but not on disordered ones, and alignment in the loss degrades agreement with SAXS. Replacing coarse-grained simulations of disordered proteins with fragment-assembled ensembles improves agreement with chemical shifts at a cost to SAXS, while an equal mixture of the two keeps most of the gain at a smaller cost. This points to the training data, rather than the architecture, as the main constraint.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质构象系综的生成模型在设计上大量继承自折叠蛋白质的结构预测。然而，有序和无序蛋白质占据不同的结构状态，我们研究设计选择在这些状态下的表现。使用最小 Cα 流匹配模型，我们消融架构、序列条件、刚体对齐和训练来源的选择，并针对划分为有序、无序、多域和过渡蛋白质的实验 SAXS 和 NMR 化学位移数据评估每个变体。专家混合路由、静态对表示和无序探针没有可检测影响；较小的蛋白质语言模型在有序蛋白质上表现更差，但在无序蛋白质上并非如此；损失中的对齐会降低与 SAXS 的一致性。用片段组装系综替换无序蛋白质的粗粒化模拟，可改善与化学位移的一致性，但以 SAXS 为代价；两者的等量混合保留了大部分增益而代价更小。这表明训练数据而非架构是主要限制。

items.title_en: A Passive Intelligent Metasurface: A Network Model
items.title_zh: 无源智能超表面：一种网络模型
items.abstract_en: Intelligent metasurfaces enable advanced wave manipulation, including negative refraction, focusing, beam splitting and beam steering, with significant potential for practical applications. However, conventional approaches often rely on active metamaterials with gain, or demand computationally intensive solutions of inverse problems to find the optimal configuration. In this work, we use the scattering framework of quantum graph theory to derive an exact, analytic expression for configuration of a passive metasurface that produces a prescribed reflected wave field. The metasurface terminates a periodic lattice of waveguides and consists of an array of channels, each a tube of length $\ell_m$ ending in a vertex whose scattering parameter $λ_m$ sets how much of the wave is lost to the wall. For any prescribed incident and reflected field, the exact lengths and scattering parameters follow channel by channel, in closed form, from the ratio of the wave amplitudes returning to and leaving the lattice, and the metasurface is passive whenever this ratio does not exceed unity in modulus. We demonstrate the construction for both a one-dimensional and a two-dimensional metasurface. The one-dimensional metasurface terminates a two-dimensional lattice and steers, splits or perfectly absorbs Gaussian beams. The two-dimensional metasurface terminates a three-dimensional lattice and generates a prescribed image in a plane inside the lattice. In each case, we obtain the exact boundary properties that produce the effect.
items.abstract_zh: 智能超表面能够实现先进的波操控，包括负折射、聚焦、分束和波束导引，具有重要的实际应用潜力。然而，传统方法通常依赖带增益的有源超材料，或需要计算密集的逆问题求解来找到最优配置。在这项工作中，我们使用量子图论的散射框架，推导出无源超表面配置的精确解析表达式，以产生规定的反射波场。该超表面终止波导的周期晶格，并由通道阵列组成，每个通道是一根长度为 ℓ_m 的管，末端是一个顶点，其散射参数 λ_m 决定有多少波损耗到壁中。对于任何规定的入射和反射场，精确长度和散射参数逐通道以闭式形式由返回和离开晶格的波幅之比给出；当该比的模不超过 1 时，超表面是无源的。我们展示了一维和二维超表面的构造。一维超表面终止二维晶格，并导引、分束或完美吸收高斯光束。二维超表面终止三维晶格，并在晶格内部的平面中生成规定图像。在每种情况下，我们获得产生该效应的精确边界属性。

items.title_en: Compositional Unalignment: Auditing Safety in Large Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 组合式去对齐：审计大型视觉语言模型的安全性
items.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are vulnerable to compositional harm: an image and a prompt that are benign in isolation become harmful through the model's cross-modal reasoning. Recent alignment methods report strong scores on compositional safety benchmarks, but an LLM judge only measures observed behavior and cannot reveal how robustly safety is integrated into the model. We argue that un-alignment provides a complementary audit of alignment robustness. We first show that minimal supervised fine-tuning reaches an LLM-judge score comparable to a multi-stage reinforcement-learning pipeline, so similar benchmark scores cannot establish robustness by themselves. We then show that recognition and refusal of compositional harm are decoupled: nine standard direction-finding methods detect compositional harm with up to AUC=0.99, yet ablating the recovered directions either leaves refusal intact or destroys model coherence. We therefore propose CMaG, a training-free un-alignment method for compositional safety. CMaG measures refusal intention with a refusal-versus-compliance log-probability margin, takes its gradient with respect to mid-layer activations, and contrasts it against partially benign pairs to isolate the cross-modal interaction term. A single backward pass over 80 examples yields a direction along which steering monotonically converts refusal into compliance. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B and LLaVA-1.5-7B, CMaG reduces compositional safety scores by up to 65 points while over 98% of outputs remain coherent, outperforming gradient-based baselines; the direction also transfers to text-explicit harm and un-aligns models hardened by defensive training. Compositional safety can thus appear behaviorally strong while remaining fragile to targeted internal intervention. Warning: this paper contains unsafe model outputs, including references to self-harm.
items.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）易受组合式危害：单独良性的图像和提示通过模型的跨模态推理变得有害。近期对齐方法在组合安全基准上报告高分，但 LLM 评判器只测量观察到的行为，无法揭示安全性被稳健整合到模型中的程度。我们认为，去对齐提供了对对齐稳健性的补充审计。我们首先表明，最小监督微调可达到与多阶段强化学习流程相当的 LLM 评判器分数，因此相似的基准分数本身不能证明稳健性。然后我们表明，组合式危害的识别与拒绝是解耦的：九种标准方向发现方法检测组合式危害的 AUC 高达 0.99，但消融恢复出的方向要么保持拒绝不变，要么破坏模型连贯性。因此，我们提出 CMaG，一种用于组合安全的免训练去对齐方法。CMaG 用拒绝与顺从的对数概率边际测量拒绝意图，对其关于中层激活求梯度，并将其与部分良性对对比，以隔离跨模态交互项。对 80 个样本进行一次反向传播，得到一个方向，沿该方向引导可单调地将拒绝转化为顺从。在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上，CMaG 将组合安全分数降低最多 65 分，同时超过 98% 的输出保持连贯，优于基于梯度的基线；该方向还可迁移到文本显式危害，并使经过防御训练强化的模型去对齐。因此，组合安全可能在行为上表现很强，但仍对针对性的内部干预很脆弱。警告：本文包含不安全的模型输出，包括提及自残。

items.title_en: Agent-R$^2$: Scaling Agents for Realistic Productivity Work via Real-Source Data Synthesis
items.title_zh: Agent-R$^2$：通过真实来源数据合成扩展用于现实生产力工作的智能体
items.abstract_en: Large language models have made rapid progress in agentic reasoning and tool use, raising expectations for agents that can take over realistic productivity work from humans. However, current agents still struggle to finish such tasks, where success requires following long-horizon professional workflows, understanding heterogeneous file contexts, and producing usable deliverables under fine-grained requirements. A key bottleneck is the lack of scalable post-training data that reflects real work intent, authentic file environments, and deliverable-level evaluation. To close this gap, we introduce Agent-R$^2$, a $\textbf{r}$eal-source data synthesis framework that scales training data for $\textbf{r}$ealistic productivity work. Instead of relying on manually specified workflows or LLM-generated files, Agent-R$^2$ grounds synthesis throughout the pipeline in real occupational seeds, corpus-derived workflow evidence, and authentic web-sourced files. From 10k web-corpus candidates, Agent-R$^2$ distills 4k task instances that pair real multi-format attachments with fine-grained, deliverable-level rubrics. On this data, we train Agent-R$^2$-4B via supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning, improving both end-to-end productivity performance and file-grounded reasoning. Trained on only 4k instances, Agent-R$^2$-4B surpasses Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 on both GDPval (51.0$\%$ vs. 48.0$\%$) and OfficeQA (14.8$\%$ vs. 13.8$\%$). Further analysis shows that Agent-R$^2$ mitigates shortcut behavior, where agents produce superficially plausible deliverables before sufficiently grounding, constructing, or verifying them, while promoting sustained exploration.
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型在智能体推理和工具使用方面取得了快速进展，提升了人们对于智能体能够接管人类现实生产力工作的期望。然而，当前智能体仍难以完成此类任务，成功需要遵循长时程专业工作流、理解异构文件上下文，并在细粒度要求下产出可用的交付物。一个关键瓶颈是缺乏可扩展的后训练数据，这些数据反映真实工作意图、真实文件环境和交付物级评估。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 Agent-R$^2$，一个真实来源数据合成框架，用于为现实生产力工作扩展训练数据。Agent-R$^2$ 不依赖人工指定的工作流或 LLM 生成的文件，而是在整个流程中将合成建立在真实职业种子、从语料库推导的工作流证据和真实网络来源文件之上。从 10k 个网络语料库候选中，Agent-R$^2$ 蒸馏出 4k 个任务实例，将真实多格式附件与细粒度、交付物级评分细则配对。在此数据上，我们通过监督微调和基于评分细则的强化学习训练 Agent-R$^2$-4B，提升端到端生产力性能和基于文件的推理。仅用 4k 个实例训练，Agent-R$^2$-4B 在 GDPval（51.0% 对 48.0%）和 OfficeQA（14.8% 对 13.8%）上均超过 Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507。进一步分析表明，Agent-R$^2$ 缓解捷径行为，即智能体在充分建立依据、构建或验证之前就产出表面看似合理的交付物，同时促进持续探索。

items.title_en: MOMASPLAT: Dynamic Novel-View Demonstration Augmentation for Mobile Manipulation
items.title_zh: MOMASPLAT：面向移动操作的动态新视角演示增强
items.abstract_en: Visuomotor policies trained through imitation learning are highly sensitive to changes in camera viewpoint. This is particularly problematic for mobile manipulation (MoMa), where robots rarely execute manipulation from the exact same base pose used during demonstration collection due to navigation uncertainty, localization drift, and environmental constraints. Recent approaches use novel-view synthesis (NVS) to augment demonstrations with unseen viewpoints, but they assume static scenes and therefore fail to re-render the manipulated object during the post-contact interaction phase, leaving the most critical parts of the demonstration unaugmented. We present MOMASPLAT, a novel-view demonstration augmentation framework for mobile manipulation that synthesizes full manipulation trajectories from unseen robot base poses, including dynamic object interactions. Our key insight is that standard MoMa data collection naturally provides the multiview observations needed to reconstruct both the static scene and the manipulated object in 3D. MOMASPLAT combines 3D Gaussian Splatting, feed-forward 3D foundation models, and kinematics-based action retargeting to separately reconstruct the scene and manipulated object, render them from novel viewpoints, and generate geometrically consistent synthetic demonstrations paired with transformed actions. We evaluate MOMASPLAT on five real-world mobile manipulation tasks involving both rigid and articulated objects across three scenes, and validate the fidelity of its synthesized demonstrations against ground truth in simulation. MOMASPLAT substantially improves robustness to unseen base poses, more than doubling the average success rate of the strongest baseline and maintaining non-trivial success at large base displacements where all baselines fail, while reducing the need for largescale real-world data collection.
items.abstract_zh: 通过模仿学习训练的视觉运动策略对相机视角变化高度敏感。这对移动操作（MoMa）尤其成问题，因为导航不确定性、定位漂移和环境约束，机器人很少从演示收集时使用的完全相同基座位姿执行操作。近期方法使用新视角合成（NVS）用未见视角增强演示，但它们假设静态场景，因此无法在接触后交互阶段重新渲染被操作物体，使演示中最关键的部分未得到增强。我们提出 MOMASPLAT，一种面向移动操作的新视角演示增强框架，可从未见机器人基座位姿合成完整操作轨迹，包括动态物体交互。我们的关键洞见是，标准 MoMa 数据收集自然提供在 3D 中重建静态场景和被操作物体所需的多视角观测。MOMASPLAT 结合 3D 高斯泼溅、前馈 3D 基础模型和基于运动学的动作重定向，分别重建场景和被操作物体，从新视角渲染它们，并生成几何一致的合成演示及变换后的动作。我们在三个场景中涉及刚性和铰接物体的五个真实世界移动操作任务上评估 MOMASPLAT，并在仿真中针对真值验证其合成演示的保真度。MOMASPLAT 显著提升对未见基座位姿的稳健性，将最强基线的平均成功率提高一倍以上，并在所有基线均失败的大基座位移下保持可观的成功率，同时减少对大规模真实世界数据收集的需求。

items.title_en: Concertina: Embodying Manipulation and Cognition in One Diffusion Vision-Language Model
items.title_zh: Concertina：将操作与认知融入一个扩散视觉-语言模型
items.abstract_en: Most vision-language-action (VLA) policies decouple manipulation from cognition by bolting an external action mechanism onto a vision-language model (VLM)--either quantizing actions into discrete tokens whose errors bear no stable correspondence to physical displacements, or delegating continuous trajectory generation to a separate action expert whose gradients compete with or are blocked from updating the VLM backbone. We argue that manipulation and cognition should instead be embodied in the same model, shifting from a decoupled VLA to an Embodied Vision-Language Model (eVLM). We introduce Concertina, an eVLM that places continuous trajectory representation, blockwise generation, and physical-coordinate supervision directly on the computation and parameter path of a shared diffusion VLM backbone. Each control timestep is encoded as one continuous latent action token in the backbone hidden space, and the shared Transformer reconstructs temporally ordered action blocks via the same corrupt-and-reconstruct operator used for multimodal pretraining. Active action projections account for only 0.21% of parameters in the 4.46B model with zero separate action-generator layers, compared with 16.5%-35.1% dedicated action-expert capacity in representative continuous VLAs. Using our proposed Action Interface Audit, we confirm that cross-time trajectory coupling emerges in the middle and late layers of the shared backbone rather than at the action interfaces. On standard benchmarks, Concertina achieves 98.15% average success on regular LIBERO, 85.9% on the 10,030-task LIBERO-Plus benchmark, and 4.142 average completed chain length on CALVIN ABC-D. Code: https://github.com/lose4578/Concertina Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/collections/Traly/concertina
items.abstract_zh: 大多数视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过将外部动作机制附加到视觉-语言模型（VLM）上来把操作与认知解耦——要么将动作量化为离散 token，其误差与物理位移没有稳定对应关系；要么将连续轨迹生成交给单独的动作专家，而其梯度会与 VLM 主干竞争或被阻止更新 VLM 主干。我们认为，操作与认知应改为体现在同一个模型中，从解耦的 VLA 转向具身视觉-语言模型（eVLM）。我们提出 Concertina，一种 eVLM，它将连续轨迹表示、分块生成和物理坐标监督直接放在共享扩散 VLM 主干的的计算与参数路径上。每个控制时间步被编码为主干隐藏空间中的一个连续潜在动作 token，共享 Transformer 通过用于多模态预训练的同一损坏-重建算子重建按时间排序的动作块。在 4.46B 模型中，活跃动作投影仅占参数的 0.21%，且没有单独的动作生成器层；相比之下，代表性连续 VLA 中专用动作专家容量为 16.5%-35.1%。使用我们提出的动作接口审计（Action Interface Audit），我们确认跨时间轨迹耦合出现在共享主干的中层和后期层，而不是在动作接口处。在标准基准上，Concertina 在常规 LIBERO 上达到 98.15% 的平均成功率，在包含 10,030 个任务的 LIBERO-Plus 基准上达到 85.9%，在 CALVIN ABC-D 上达到 4.142 的平均完成链长。代码：https://github.com/lose4578/Concertina Hugging Face：https://huggingface.co/collections/Traly/concertina

items.title_en: Predicting protein structures at any folding stage from sequence
items.title_zh: 从序列预测任意折叠阶段的蛋白质结构
items.abstract_en: Protein structure prediction has largely focused on native conformations, leaving the continuum of unfolded states, folding intermediates, and native structures difficult to access. We present FoldScape, a sequence-conditioned deep learning framework for generating protein conformational ensembles at specified folding fractions $Q$. Trained on approximately one million conformations from 10,000 protein sequences, FoldScape combines coarse-grained folding and all-atom mechanical-unfolding trajectories. It reconstructs three-dimensional $C_α$ chains through hierarchical sliding-window regressions of inter-residue distances, chain-level assembly, and a rectified-flow decoder. By conditioning on folding progress, FoldScape generates conformations from unfolded states through intermediates to native-state structures without protein-specific molecular dynamics at inference. In matched-sample comparisons, FoldScape achieves median conformational-space coverage of 0.989, 0.722, and 0.877 along radius of gyration, fraction of native contacts $Q$, and secondary-structure fraction, respectively, versus 0.05, 0.05, and 0.10 for seed-varied AlphaFold 3 ensembles. Coverage advantages are consistent across the evaluated proteins and robust to binning choices. Reconstruction accuracy remains approximately stable across the evaluated stages of a folding trajectory, and stride-one crop-and-superpose inference extends predictions to chains several times longer than the single-pass limit. Analyses of mechanical-unfolding trajectories show residue-resolved pathways, reproducible extension-conditioned observables across pulling velocities, and geometrically coherent segments in partially unfolded chains. FoldScape extends sequence-based structure prediction beyond a single folded endpoint to controllable conformational-ensemble generation across protein folding.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质结构预测在很大程度上集中于天然构象，使得未折叠状态、折叠中间体和天然结构构成的连续体难以获取。我们提出 FoldScape，一个以序列为条件的深度学习框架，用于在指定折叠分数 Q 下生成蛋白质构象系综。FoldScape 在来自 10,000 个蛋白质序列的约一百万个构象上训练，结合粗粒化折叠和全原子机械展开轨迹。它通过残基间距离的层次滑动窗口回归、链级组装和 rectified-flow 解码器重建三维 Cα 链。通过以折叠进程为条件，FoldScape 在推理时无需针对特定蛋白质的分子动力学即可生成从未折叠状态经中间体到天然态结构的构象。在匹配样本比较中，FoldScape 沿回转半径、天然接触分数 Q 和二级结构分数分别达到 0.989、0.722 和 0.877 的构象空间中位覆盖率，而种子变化的 AlphaFold 3 系综分别为 0.05、0.05 和 0.10。覆盖率优势在所评估蛋白质中一致，并且对分箱选择稳健。重建精度在折叠轨迹的所评估阶段大致保持稳定，步长为1的裁剪-叠加推理将预测扩展到比单次通过限制长数倍的链。对机械展开轨迹的分析显示了残基分辨路径、跨拉伸速度可重复的以伸展为条件的可观测量，以及部分展开链中几何一致的片段。FoldScape 将基于序列的结构预测从单一折叠终点扩展到跨蛋白质折叠的可控构象系综生成。

items.title_en: Approaching quantum limits in sub-Rayleigh resolution using phase modulation optimization
items.title_zh: 利用相位调制优化逼近亚瑞利分辨率下的量子极限
items.abstract_en: Spatial-mode demultiplexing (SPADE) has made significant progress in incoherent optical imaging and has been implemented through various experimental approaches. Holography-based SPADE is widely used in proof-of-principle experiments because of its low cost, stable optical arrangement, and ease of implementation. However, its low photon utilization severely limits its practical applications. Alternating Fourier transforms and phase modulations can implement unitary optical transformations. Building on this idea, we use backpropagation to optimize the phase profiles of spatial light modulators (SLMs) and thereby design quantum measurements that are efficient in both information and energy. We study centroid--separation estimation for two incoherent point sources, using Fisher information or the estimation errors of an auxiliary neural network estimator as optimization objectives. As the number of SLMs increases, the optimized measurements approach the quantum limits characterized by the quantum Cramér-Rao bound and the information-regret tradeoff relation. With a few SLMs, our method can outperform direct imaging, showing its potential for superresolution imaging.
items.abstract_zh: 空间模式解复用（SPADE）在非相干光学成像中已取得显著进展，并已通过多种实验方法实现。基于全息的 SPADE 因其低成本、稳定光路和易于实现而被广泛用于原理验证实验。然而，其低光子利用率严重限制了实际应用。交替傅里叶变换和相位调制可以实现酉光学变换。基于这一思想，我们使用反向传播优化空间光调制器（SLM）的相位分布，从而设计在信息和能量两方面都高效的量子测量。我们研究两个非相干点源的质心-间距估计，使用 Fisher 信息或辅助神经网络估计器的估计误差作为优化目标。随着 SLM 数量增加，优化后的测量逼近由量子 Cramér-Rao 界和信息遗憾权衡关系所表征的量子极限。使用少量 SLM 时，我们的方法可以优于直接成像，显示其在超分辨成像中的潜力。

items.title_en: Aero-VPA: Few-Step Flow-Matching Control over Non-Reconstructive JEPA Latents for Agile Flight on Edge Hardware
items.title_zh: Aero-VPA：在边缘硬件上对非重建式 JEPA 潜在变量进行少步流匹配控制以实现敏捷飞行
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generalize across tasks, but their autoregressive decoders need sequential forward passes in proportion to the action horizon, each bounded below on embedded aerial platforms by streaming billions of parameters from memory. We present Aero-VPA, a lightweight Vision-Predictor-Action architecture for 3D navigation on edge hardware. A compact RGB-D Vision Transformer and a five-head ensemble predictor, trained without pixel reconstruction, forecast the next latent state; a Conditional Flow Matching solver generates a velocity and yaw-rate chunk in two Euler steps, so each decision takes five sequential network evaluations; and the ensemble dispersion drives an uncertainty fallback. Version 1 specified the architecture, deployment and protocol without results. This version reports the first closed-loop evaluation: PX4 software-in-the-loop simulation of quadrotor missions in procedurally generated forests. Behaviour cloning failed on all 60 missions despite open-loop errors of 0.02-0.04 m/s: the policy copies its last command, a copycat form of causal confusion. DAgger with a privileged, safety-gated supervisor gave the first successes but plateaued at 11.1-21.1% across six checkpoints. A map-free runtime shield with a 15 s depth memory, barrier constraints, a cap on motion outside the 73-degree field of view and backoff along the flown path raised the first DAgger policy's success on 180 paired missions from 21.1% to 52.2% (95% CI [45.0, 59.4]; exact McNemar p = 1.2 x 10^-10) and cut its crashes from 72.2% to 22.2%, while timeouts rose from 2.8% to 23.3%. All six checkpoints gained 30.0-34.4 percentage points, at mean speeds of 1.16-1.36 m/s. The code (https://github.com/ylee-sling/Aero-VPA), the trained policy (72.6 MB, https://huggingface.co/ylee-sling/aero-vpa) and the full benchmark dataset are public.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型可跨任务泛化，但其自回归解码器需要与动作时域成正比的顺序前向传递，而在嵌入式空中平台上，每次传递的下界是从内存中流式传输数十亿参数。我们提出 Aero-VPA，一种用于边缘硬件上三维导航的轻量级视觉-预测-动作架构。一个紧凑的 RGB-D Vision Transformer 和一个五头集成预测器在不进行像素重建的情况下训练，预测下一潜在状态；条件流匹配求解器通过两个欧拉步生成速度与偏航角速度块，因此每次决策进行五次顺序网络评估；集成离散度驱动不确定性回退。版本1规定了架构、部署和协议，但没有结果。本版本报告首次闭环评估：在程序化生成的森林中对四旋翼任务进行 PX4 软件在环仿真。行为克隆在所有60个任务上失败，尽管开环误差为0.02-0.04 m/s：策略复制其最后指令，这是一种照抄式因果混淆。带有特权、安全门控监督器的 DAgger 给出了首批成功，但在六个检查点上停滞于11.1-21.1%。一个无地图运行时防护罩具有15秒深度记忆、障碍约束、对73度视场外运动的限制以及沿已飞路径后退，将第一个 DAgger 策略在180个配对任务上的成功率从21.1%提高到52.2%（95% CI [45.0, 59.4]；精确 McNemar p = 1.2 x 10^-10），并将其碰撞率从72.2%降至22.2%，同时超时率从2.8%升至23.3%。所有六个检查点提升了30.0-34.4个百分点，平均速度为1.16-1.36 m/s。代码（https://github.com/ylee-sling/Aero-VPA）、训练策略（72.6 MB，https://huggingface.co/ylee-sling/aero-vpa）和完整基准数据集均已公开。

items.title_en: Knowing When to Teach: Learning from Teachable Prefixes in Multilingual Reasoning Distillation
items.title_zh: 知道何时教学：在多语言推理蒸馏中从可教学前缀学习
items.abstract_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a student on its own reasoning, using the same model conditioned on reference solutions as a teacher. Applying OPSD to multilingual reasoning requires the teacher to provide useful feedback across languages, even when the student makes mistakes in intermediate steps. We observe a phenomenon we call Teacher Drift: as these mistakes accumulate, the teacher may follow the student's incorrect steps instead of correcting them. Our analysis shows that this shift tends to occur earlier in lower-resource languages. To account for these differences across languages, we propose Teachable On-Policy Self-Distillation (TOPSD), which determines where and whether teacher supervision should be applied to each reasoning trajectory. TOPSD uses teacher-student likelihood to estimate where drift begins and select a prefix for supervision. It then verifies whether the teacher can recover the correct answer from that prefix, applying distillation only to prefixes that pass verification. Experiments on multilingual mathematical reasoning across ten languages and three model scales show that TOPSD consistently outperforms conventional OPSD, particularly in low- and medium-resource languages.
items.abstract_zh: 同策略自蒸馏（OPSD）通过让学生模型基于自身推理进行训练来改进推理，并使用同一模型以参考解为条件作为教师。将 OPSD 应用于多语言推理要求教师跨语言提供有用反馈，即使学生在中间步骤犯错。我们观察到一种称为 Teacher Drift 的现象：随着这些错误累积，教师可能跟随学生的不正确步骤，而不是纠正它们。我们的分析表明，这种偏移在较低资源语言中往往更早发生。为了考虑这些跨语言差异，我们提出可教学同策略自蒸馏（TOPSD），它确定应对每条推理轨迹在何处以及是否应用教师监督。TOPSD 使用师生似然来估计漂移开始的位置并选择用于监督的前缀。然后它验证教师能否从该前缀恢复正确答案，仅对通过验证的前缀应用蒸馏。在跨十种语言和三种模型规模的多语言数学推理实验中，TOPSD 始终优于传统 OPSD，尤其是在低资源和中资源语言中。

items.title_en: OopsieRecover: Learning Transferable VLA Corrections from Semantic Interventions
items.title_zh: OopsieRecover：从语义干预中学习可迁移的 VLA 修正
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can perform a wide range of robotic manipulation tasks, but often fail during deployment. Teaching them to recover from these failures requires substantial corrective data: existing approaches learn to recover from failures by directly associating corrective actions with the observations in which they were demonstrated. For instance, DAgger-like fine-tuning can require tens to hundreds of interactions, yet the resulting policy may still fail to generalize the learned corrections beyond the demonstrated scenarios. We hypothesize that semantics can capture the underlying reasons for failures and their corrections, enabling policies to learn from only a handful of corrective demonstrations and generalize those corrections to novel objects, and scene variations. We propose OopsieRecover, a framework that uses abduction to infer the intent behind a small set of corrective demonstrations and encodes the inferred knowledge as dense spatial representations and conditional costs. These costs capture when a behavior is undesirable and steer the policy toward more desirable action regions. We experiment across 6 tasks and variations in object poses, scenes, and related tasks, and find that only a handful of corrective demonstrations can enable a VLA to overcome failures across a broad range of novel situations, without requiring new corrective data for each variation. Please refer to https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/oopsierecover for videos.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型可以执行广泛的机器人操作任务，但在部署期间常常失败。教它们从这些失败中恢复需要大量纠正数据：现有方法通过将纠正动作与演示这些动作的观测直接关联来学习从失败中恢复。例如，类 DAgger 微调可能需要数十到数百次交互，但所得策略仍可能无法将学到的纠正泛化到演示场景之外。我们假设语义可以捕捉失败及其纠正背后的原因，使策略仅从少量纠正演示中学习，并将这些纠正泛化到新物体和场景变化。我们提出 OopsieRecover，一个使用溯因推理从一小组纠正演示中推断意图，并将推断知识编码为稠密空间表示和条件代价的框架。这些代价捕捉行为何时不可取，并引导策略朝向更可取的动作区域。我们在6个任务以及物体位姿、场景和相关任务变化上进行实验，发现仅少量纠正演示就能使 VLA 克服广泛新情况下的失败，而无需为每种变化提供新的纠正数据。视频见 https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/oopsierecover。

items.title_en: Wide View Synthesis from Overlapping Perspective Cameras in Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: 自动驾驶中基于重叠透视相机的宽视角合成
items.abstract_en: Multi-perspective-camera systems are widely adopted since they provide broad visual coverage for autonomous driving, motivating the synthesis of a unified wide view from spatially separated observations. In this work, we formulate wide view synthesis (WVS), which aims to synthesize a geometrically consistent wide view at a specified virtual viewpoint from multiple perspective cameras. Unlike conventional image stitching, WVS requires reasoning about 3D geometry and visibility to handle depth-dependent parallax and occlusions arising from spatially separated camera centers. While vanilla 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-fidelity view synthesis, its reliance on per-scene optimization limits its applicability to driving scenes. Furthermore, WVS introduces additional challenges, *e.g.*, peripheral stretching under perspective projection and photometric inconsistencies across cameras. To address these challenges, we propose **Wide-View Gaussian Splatting (WV-GS)**, a feed-forward Gaussian-splatting framework that synthesizes wide views without per-scene optimization. Specifically, we introduce Piecewise Perspective Rendering (PPR) to mitigate peripheral stretching through local perspective projections sharing a common camera center, and Spatial Affine Photometric Modeling (SAPM) to account for camera-dependent photometric variations during training. We further introduce **WideDrive**, a synthetic benchmark providing dense ground-truth wide views and adapt a LiDAR-projected sparse-reference protocol to real-world datasets. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of WV-GS for WVS. Dataset and code will be publicly released.
items.abstract_zh: 多透视相机系统被广泛采用，因为它们为自动驾驶提供广阔的视觉覆盖，这推动了从空间分离的观测中合成统一宽视角的研究。在本工作中，我们形式化宽视角合成（WVS）任务，旨在从多个透视相机在指定虚拟视点处合成几何一致的宽视角。与传统图像拼接不同，WVS 需要推理三维几何与可见性，以处理由空间分离的相机中心引起的深度相关视差与遮挡。虽然原始 3D 高斯溅射（3DGS）能够实现高保真视角合成，但其依赖逐场景优化，限制了其在驾驶场景中的适用性。此外，WVS 引入了额外挑战，例如透视投影下的周边拉伸以及跨相机的光度不一致。为应对这些挑战，我们提出宽视角高斯溅射（WV-GS），一种无需逐场景优化即可合成宽视角的前馈高斯溅射框架。具体而言，我们引入分段透视渲染（PPR），通过共享同一相机中心的局部透视投影来缓解周边拉伸；并引入空间仿射光度建模（SAPM），以在训练中考虑相机相关的光度变化。我们进一步引入 WideDrive，一个提供密集真值宽视角的合成基准，并将 LiDAR 投影的稀疏参考协议适配到真实世界数据集。在多个数据集上的大量实验证明了 WV-GS 对 WVS 的有效性。数据集和代码将公开释放。

items.title_en: ProteoCraft: Protein Design as Proposal-Verification Search
items.title_zh: ProteoCraft：蛋白质设计作为提议-验证搜索
items.abstract_en: Protein-protein interactions underpin nearly all biological processes. Yet, designing proteins with desired interactions remains challenging due to the structural complexity governing molecular recognition. This study views protein design as a search optimization problem over a combinatorial sequence space under expensive structural evaluation. Toward this goal, we introduce a novel tree-based search framework, ProteoCraft, that employs approximate structural gradients from diffusion-based structure predictors as effective proposal policies to specify where the search should explore. Complete no-gradient inference of folding models separately assigns values to the resulting sequences, determining what is good. ProteoCraft allocates this verification budget through a coarse-to-fine paradigm: multi-site edits first explore distinct sequence basins, then verified promising states undergo strict single-site refinement. Across fourteen de novo binder-design settings spanning eight target proteins, five immune-relevant TCR-facing targets, and four localized CDR redesign tasks, ProteoCraft improves design quality and high-confidence yield. These improvements persist under independent AF2-IG and Rosetta-based interface evaluation. Prospective experimental validation further yielded an 82.9% binding hit rate for PD-L1 miniproteins, with a best measured KD of 0.879 nM, and confirmed binding of designed IFNAR2 VHH. Our code is available at https://github.com/smiles724/ProteoCraft_v1.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用支撑几乎所有生物过程。然而，由于支配分子识别的结构复杂性，设计具有所需相互作用的蛋白质仍然具有挑战性。本研究将蛋白质设计视为在昂贵结构评估下、组合序列空间上的搜索优化问题。为此，我们引入一种新颖的基于树的搜索框架 ProteoCraft，它采用来自基于扩散的结构预测器的近似结构梯度作为有效的提议策略，以指定搜索应在何处探索。折叠模型的完整无梯度推理分别对所得序列赋值，判断何为好。ProteoCraft 通过由粗到细的范式分配这种验证预算：多位点编辑首先探索不同的序列盆地，然后经核实的有希望状态接受严格的单位点细化。在涵盖八个靶蛋白、五个免疫相关 TCR 面向靶点和四个局部 CDR 重设计任务的十四个从头结合体设计设置中，ProteoCraft 提高了设计质量和高置信度产量。这些改进在独立的 AF2-IG 和基于 Rosetta 的界面评估下仍然存在。前瞻性实验验证进一步使 PD-L1 微型蛋白的结合命中率达到 82.9%，最佳测得 KD 为 0.879 nM，并确认了设计的 IFNAR2 VHH 的结合。我们的代码见 https://github.com/smiles724/ProteoCraft_v1。

items.title_en: Development of time-resolved fluorescence spectroscopy using heralded emission spectroscopy for organic light-emitting materials
items.title_zh: 基于预报发射光谱的有机发光材料时间分辨荧光光谱开发
items.abstract_en: Organic light-emitting materials are widely used in optoelectronics and bioimaging, but sometimes conventional fluorescence spectroscopy techniques can be limited by scattering, background fluorescence, photon pile-up and photobleaching. We report a quantum-spectroscopic approach using frequency-entangled, nondegenerate photon pairs generated via spontaneous parametric down-conversion with heralded detection, to perform photoluminescence lifetime measurements at low excitation intensities. We demonstrate this approach across three organic light-emitting material classes: the fluorescent dye Rhodamine 6G, an organic semiconducting conjugated polymer poly[2-methoxy-5-(2-ethylhexyloxy)-1,4-phenylenevinylene] (MEH-PPV), and a fluorescent protein mOrange. The intrinsic timing correlation between signal and idler photons enables coincidence gating that suppresses uncorrelated background counts. Across all materials and integration times of 500, 1000 and 3600 seconds, heralded detection yields signal-to-noise ratios 1.6-3.0 times higher than classical pulsed-laser excitation attenuated to match heralded photon counts in the fitting range. For MEH-PPV, this roughly halves the noise amplitude. Our measured lifetimes closely match long-integration classical pulsed-laser reference values.
items.abstract_zh: 有机发光材料广泛用于光电子学和生物成像，但传统荧光光谱技术有时会受到散射、背景荧光、光子堆积和光漂白的限制。我们报告一种量子光谱方法，利用通过自发参量下转换产生的频率纠缠、非简并光子对并结合预报探测，在低激发强度下进行光致发光寿命测量。我们在三类有机发光材料上演示了该方法：荧光染料罗丹明 6G、有机半导体共轭聚合物聚[2-甲氧基-5-(2-乙基己氧基)-1,4-苯撑乙烯撑]（MEH-PPV）以及荧光蛋白 mOrange。信号光子和闲频光子之间的内在时间关联使符合门控能够抑制不相关背景计数。在所有材料和 500、1000 和 3600 秒的积分时间下，与衰减到在拟合范围内匹配预报光子计数的经典脉冲激光激发相比，预报探测产生的信噪比高 1.6–3.0 倍。对于 MEH-PPV，这大约使噪声幅度减半。我们测得的寿命与长积分经典脉冲激光参考值密切匹配。

items.title_en: RangeFinder: Predicting Ligand Property Ranges from Protein Pockets
items.title_zh: RangeFinder：从蛋白质口袋预测配体性质范围
items.abstract_en: Identifying ligands for a protein target requires searching a vast chemical space for a comparatively small set of compatible molecules. Existing machine learning approaches primarily address this problem by generating candidate ligands or scoring individual protein-ligand pairs, but provide limited information about the broader chemical space compatible with a binding pocket. We introduce RangeFinder, an SE(3)-equivariant transformer pocket-level model, trained and evaluated on BioLiP2 data, that predicts ranges over nine physicochemical ligand properties directly from pocket structure, chemistry, and evolutionary context. Using an intersection-over-union objective and evaluation metric (range-IoU), RangeFinder achieves a range-IoU of $0.464 \pm 0.002$, outperforming all deployable baselines while requiring only $12.2$ ms per pocket. We also quantify our method's ability to reduce the ligand search space while retaining compatible binders; in this regard, RangeFinder achieves a Reduction-Recall F-Score of $0.543 \pm 0.011$ --- once again outperforming all deployable baselines. Ablation experiments indicate that RangeFinder's performance depends more strongly on the density and quality of ligand supervision than on any individual input modality or specialized training strategy. Together, these results position RangeFinder as an inexpensive and effective molecular filtering prior, with demonstrated potential in narrowing the ligand search space of target pockets before docking, generation, or synthesis. The code for this project can be found at: https://github.com/alannadels/RangeFinder.
items.abstract_zh: 为蛋白质靶标识别配体需要在巨大的化学空间中搜索相对较小的一组兼容分子。现有机器学习方法主要通过生成候选配体或对单个蛋白质-配体对打分来解决该问题，但关于与结合口袋兼容的更广泛化学空间所提供的信息有限。我们引入 RangeFinder，一种 SE(3)-等变 transformer 口袋级模型，在 BioLiP2 数据上训练和评估，可直接从口袋结构、化学性质和进化背景预测九种配体物理化学性质的范围。使用交并比目标与评估指标（range-IoU），RangeFinder 达到 0.464 ± 0.002 的 range-IoU，优于所有可部署基线，同时每个口袋仅需 12.2 ms。我们还量化了该方法在保留兼容结合体的同时减少配体搜索空间的能力；在这方面，RangeFinder 达到 0.543 ± 0.011 的 Reduction-Recall F-Score，再次优于所有可部署基线。消融实验表明，RangeFinder 的性能更强烈地依赖于配体监督的密度和质量，而不是任何单个输入模态或专门训练策略。总之，这些结果将 RangeFinder 定位为一种廉价且有效的分子过滤先验，在对接、生成或合成之前缩小靶标口袋的配体搜索空间方面具有已展示的潜力。项目代码见：https://github.com/alannadels/RangeFinder。

items.title_en: Automatic keyphrase extraction and annotation: modern theoretical approaches and practical solutions for text and speech
items.title_zh: 自动关键短语提取与标注：文本和语音的现代理论方法与实践解决方案
items.abstract_en: The exponential growth of textual and audiovisual information has made the task of automatic keyphrase extraction (KE) increasingly significant. This article provides a comprehensive analysis of contemporary theoretical approaches and practical solutions for KE across both text and speech modalities. The primary contribution of this work is its systematic synthesis of these often-disparate research strands into a unified analytical framework, highlighting the evolution of the field from statistical methods towards large language models (LLMs) and end-to-end speech processing. We examine the stages of KE, the characteristics of keyphrases in written and spoken language, and terminological nuances. Various methods for automatic KE are discussed and analyzed in detail: statistical, hybrid, machine learning-based, and structural. The review dedicates substantial attention to emerging paradigms, including keyphrase generation using LLMs, and provides a detailed overview of methodologies and challenges in automatic corpus annotation. Furthermore, we specifically analyze current directions and inherent difficulties in KE for spoken language, comparing transcript based and end-to-end acoustic approaches. This synthesis leads us to conclude that the field is moving towards a more integrated, context-aware paradigm. Future progress will depend on addressing key challenges such as data scarcity for low-resource languages, effective multimodal fusion, and the nuanced evaluation of generative KE systems.
items.abstract_zh: 文本和视听信息的指数增长使自动关键短语提取（KE）任务日益重要。本文对文本和语音两种模态中 KE 的当代理论方法与实践解决方案进行了全面分析。本工作的主要贡献在于将这些往往彼此分离的研究脉络系统性地综合为一个统一分析框架，突出该领域从统计方法向大语言模型（LLM）和端到端语音处理的演进。我们考察 KE 的阶段、书面语和口语中关键短语的特征以及术语细微差别。详细讨论和分析了各种自动 KE 方法：统计方法、混合方法、基于机器学习的方法和结构方法。综述重点关注新兴范式，包括使用 LLM 的关键短语生成，并详细概述自动语料标注的方法与挑战。此外，我们专门分析口语 KE 的当前方向与内在困难，比较基于转写文本的方法和端到端声学方法。这一综合使我们得出结论：该领域正朝着更集成、上下文感知的范式发展。未来进展将取决于应对低资源语言数据稀缺、有效多模态融合以及对生成式 KE 系统进行细致评估等关键挑战。

items.title_en: Energy-Aware Open-Vocabulary Detection Scheduling for Low-Power Robotic Autonomy
items.title_zh: 面向低功耗机器人自主的能量感知开放词汇检测调度
items.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) lets robots search for run-time object queries, but fixed-rate inference spends embedded compute on low-value frames during idle motion, map revisits, or stable viewpoints. This paper presents an energy-aware OVD scheduler for low-power mobile robots. The scheduler uses odometry, map change, and detector confidence to switch among low-, mid-, and high-power YOLO-World-S modes on a Jetson Orin Nano. We evaluate the energy-quality trade-off on an AgileX LIMO using 40 real navigation trials: two target objects, five placements per target-policy pair, and four perception policies. Across bottle and cup trials, the scheduler records 8/10 mission success compared with 7/10 for each fixed-rate baseline, while reducing mean Jetson input power (a Jetson-side power-draw metric) by 5.2% relative to an 8 Hz high-rate baseline and lowering achieved OVD call rate by 34.0%. It does not minimize mission-window Jetson input energy because longer missions can erase instantaneous power savings. A separate 60 s stationary microbenchmark isolates the perception workload: the scheduler lowers mean power from 8.045 W to 7.301 W and energy from 484.7 J to 438.1 J relative to the 8 Hz baseline. These results support robot-state-aware OVD scheduling as a promising power-management mechanism with competitive task reliability, while showing that mission-window Jetson input energy must be read together with task progress and runtime.
items.abstract_zh: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）让机器人能够搜索运行时对象查询，但固定速率推理会在空闲运动、地图重访或稳定视点期间将嵌入式计算花费在低价值帧上。本文提出一种面向低功耗移动机器人的能量感知 OVD 调度器。该调度器利用里程计、地图变化和检测器置信度，在 Jetson Orin Nano 上的低、中、高功率 YOLO-World-S 模式之间切换。我们使用 40 次真实导航试验在 AgileX LIMO 上评估能量-质量权衡：两个目标物体、每个目标-策略对五种放置以及四种感知策略。在瓶子和杯子试验中，调度器记录 8/10 任务成功，而每个固定速率基线为 7/10，同时相对于 8 Hz 高速率基线将平均 Jetson 输入功率（一种 Jetson 侧功耗指标）降低 5.2%，并将实际达到的 OVD 调用率降低 34.0%。它并未最小化任务窗口内的 Jetson 输入能量，因为更长的任务可能抵消瞬时功率节省。单独的 60 秒静止微基准隔离感知工作负载：相对于 8 Hz 基线，调度器将平均功率从 8.045 W 降至 7.301 W，并将能量从 484.7 J 降至 438.1 J。这些结果支持将机器人状态感知的 OVD 调度作为一种具有竞争力的任务可靠性前景的功率管理机制，同时表明任务窗口内的 Jetson 输入能量必须结合任务进展和运行时间解读。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为用于视图合成的神经辐射场
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集合优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续5D坐标（空间位置$(x,y,z)$和观察方向$(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和与视角相关的发射辐射度。我们通过沿相机光线查询5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何结构和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行比较。

items.title_en: Automatic Generation of Novel Highly-Functional Molecular Sequences
items.title_zh: 自动生成新型高功能分子序列
items.abstract_en: While multiple methods now exist to generate functional sequence variants from existing annotated examples, it is unclear how well such methods can be used to generate sequences that exceed the functionality of those contained in the example set. Using two complete fitness landscapes, we quantify how effectively generative tools can search sequence space and find rare, novel, highly functional sequences, focusing on variational auto-encoders and information-theoretic methods. We find that an information-theoretic method that does not require training and runs significantly faster than standard Machine-Learning/Artificial Intelligence (ML/AI) methods also is significantly more effective in finding rare highly-functional sequences. We discuss the application of this novel method to discover rare polypeptides with anti-bacterial properties that are specific to bacterial, but not eukaryotic, cell membranes.
items.abstract_zh: 虽然现在已经存在多种方法可以从现有带注释示例中生成功能序列变体，但这些方法在生成超过示例集中所含功能的功能序列方面效果如何仍不清楚。使用两个完整的适应度景观，我们量化了生成工具能够多有效地搜索序列空间并找到稀有、新型、高功能序列，重点关注变分自编码器和信息论方法。我们发现，一种不需要训练且运行速度显著快于标准机器学习/人工智能（ML/AI）方法的信息论方法，在发现稀有高功能序列方面也显著更有效。我们讨论了这种新方法在发现具有抗细菌特性的稀有 polypeptides 中的应用，这些多肽对细菌细胞膜具有特异性，而不对真核细胞膜具有特异性。

items.title_en: Unified design of short mode-evolution couplers
items.title_zh: 短模演化耦合器的统一设计
items.abstract_en: Short mode-evolution couplers have been designed with several seemingly different approaches, including fast quasi-adiabatic dynamics (FAQUAD), counter-diabatic (CD) driving realized by tailoring waveguide widths and spacing, CD driving realized by axis bending, and numerical optimization of the coupler geometry. Using exact two-mode coupled-mode theory in the Kramers--Henneberger frame of the bent coupler, we show that these approaches belong to the same design space. The three geometric parameters, width difference, spacing, and axis tilt, act on the light through two functions only: the coupling strength, set by the spacing, and an effective detuning, set by the width difference and the axis curvature. The gauge, bent, and mixed realizations of a CD coupler are therefore the same device and have the same bandwidth. The bandwidth is set by the angle $χ$ between the light and the field that steers it on the Bloch sphere, integrated along the device as $\int\sin^2χdz$, and for a CD coupler this integral is set by the reference alone. This leads to a lithography-aware design rule: make the reference as adiabatic as the minimum gap allows, by narrowing its spacing at the anticrossing, and let exact CD suppress the remaining nonadiabatic coupling. In beam propagation method (BPM) simulations on a polymer platform, a 500\um{} coupler designed this way, without numerical optimization, maintains ${>}99\%$ transfer over 274~nm at a minimum edge gap of 1.05\um, compared with 150~nm for the CD coupler of a fixed-spacing reference at nearly the same gap. Particle swarm optimization of the geometry with BPM in the loop does not exceed the design rule. Three-dimensional BPM of the BCB channel waveguides also confirms these conclusions.
items.abstract_zh: 短模演化耦合器已采用几种看似不同的方法进行设计，包括快速准绝热动力学（FAQUAD）、通过定制波导宽度和间距实现的反绝热（CD）驱动、通过轴弯曲实现的CD驱动，以及耦合器几何结构的数值优化。在弯曲耦合器的Kramers--Henneberger框架中使用精确双模耦合模理论，我们表明这些方法属于同一设计空间。三个几何参数——宽度差、间距和轴倾斜——仅通过两个函数作用于光：耦合强度（由间距设定）和有效失谐（由宽度差和轴曲率设定）。因此，CD耦合器的规范、弯曲和混合实现是同一器件，并且具有相同带宽。带宽由光与在Bloch球上操控它的场之间的角度$χ$设定，沿器件积分为$\int\sin^2χdz$，对于CD耦合器，该积分仅由参考决定。这引出一条光刻感知的设计规则：通过收窄反交叉处的间距，使参考在最小间隙允许的范围内尽可能绝热，并让精确CD抑制剩余的非绝热耦合。在聚合物平台上的光束传播法（BPM）仿真中，一个按此方式设计、无需数值优化的500\um{}耦合器，在1.05\um{}的最小边缘间隙下，在274~nm范围内保持${>}99\%$的传输，相比之下，固定间距参考的CD耦合器在几乎相同间隙下为150~nm。在环路中结合BPM对几何结构进行粒子群优化并未超过该设计规则。BCB通道波导的三维BPM也证实了这些结论。

items.title_en: HistoTx: Early fusion of H&E images and spatial transcriptomics at varying spatial transcriptomics resolution with self-supervised learning
items.title_zh: HistoTx：在不同空间转录组分辨率下通过自监督学习对H&E图像和空间转录组学进行早期融合
items.abstract_en: Spatial transcriptomics maps gene expression across tissue sections and, when integrated with whole slide images, jointly captures both morphological architecture and molecular activity to provide a rich, multimodal view of tissue biology. ML approaches combining spatial transcriptomics and WSIs typically learn a mapping from morphological features to molecular profiles via contrastive alignment or supervised fine-tuning of pathology foundation models. In both cases, transcriptomics serves as a training signal rather than a true input modality, leaving inference fundamentally image-driven. We propose an early-fusion vision transformer architecture in which transcript tokens are constructed at arbitrary spatial resolution, merged with image patch tokens, and jointly processed through a shared transformer stack for deep cross-modal interaction. Starting from a pretrained vision-only pathology foundation model, we train HistoTx by continuing self-supervised pretraining on paired image and spatial transcriptomics data and demonstrate that: 1) at inference with image only, performance remains on par with the baseline on most tasks while improving on tasks that inherently benefit from molecular knowledge, such as gene expression prediction; 2) when both modalities are available at inference, jointly providing image and transcript inputs outperforms either modality alone.
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学在整个组织切片上映射基因表达，当与全切片图像整合时，可共同捕获形态结构和分子活动，从而提供组织生物学的丰富多模态视图。结合空间转录组学和WSI的机器学习方法通常通过对比对齐或病理基础模型的监督微调，学习从形态特征到分子谱的映射。在这两种情况下，转录组学都作为训练信号而非真正的输入模态，使推理从根本上由图像驱动。我们提出一种早期融合视觉Transformer架构，其中转录本token以任意空间分辨率构建，与图像块token合并，并通过共享Transformer堆栈联合处理，以实现深度跨模态交互。从预训练的仅视觉病理基础模型开始，我们通过在配对的图像和空间转录组学数据上继续自监督预训练来训练HistoTx，并证明：1）在仅使用图像进行推理时，性能在大多数任务上与基线持平，同时在本质上受益于分子知识的任务（如基因表达预测）上有所提高；2）当推理时两种模态均可用时，联合提供图像和转录本输入优于任一单独模态。

items.title_en: Generate-then-Rank: Learning Symbolic Goal Interpretation for Embodied Agents
items.title_zh: Generate-then-Rank：为具身智能体学习符号目标解释
items.abstract_en: Goal interpretation is to translate a natural language instruction into a formal symbolic goal that a planner can execute. It is critical for embodied agents because any error here propagates to every downstream planning and action step. Doing it well requires both generating suitable candidates and reliably selecting among them. We present a two-stage generate-then-rank approach to Goal Interpretation in the Embodied Agent Interface (EAI). First, supervised fine-tuning adapts a Large Language Model (LLM) to EAI's output convention. Second, Candidate-Output Ranking from Errors (CORE) learns preferences over complete outputs from the model's own generated alternatives. We conducted experiments on the household scenes of the Embodied Agent Interface Benchmark. Multiple open source LLMs including DeepSeek-V3 chat, DeepSeek-Reasoner, and Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2.5-72B were evaluated. The proposed method outperformed the baseline models including LLMs with simple prompting, chain-of-thought, and knowledge graph based approaches.
items.abstract_zh: 目标解释是将自然语言指令转换为规划器可执行的形式化符号目标。这对具身智能体至关重要，因为此处的任何错误都会传播到每个下游规划和动作步骤。要做好这一点，既需要生成合适的候选，又需要在其中可靠选择。我们提出一种在具身智能体接口（EAI）中进行目标解释的两阶段“先生成后排序”方法。首先，监督微调使大语言模型（LLM）适应EAI的输出约定。其次，基于错误的候选输出排序（CORE）从模型自身生成的备选输出中学习对完整输出的偏好。我们在具身智能体接口基准的家庭场景上进行了实验。评估了多个开源LLM，包括DeepSeek-V3 chat、DeepSeek-Reasoner以及Qwen2.5-7B和Qwen2.5-72B。所提方法优于基线模型，包括采用简单提示、思维链和基于知识图谱方法的LLM。

items.title_en: TwinBridge: Digital Twin-Driven Policy and Reward Transfer for Real-World Reinforcement Learning in Laboratory Robotics
items.title_zh: TwinBridge：面向实验室机器人真实世界强化学习的数字孪生驱动策略与奖励迁移
items.abstract_en: Online reinforcement learning offers an effective approach to precise laboratory manipulation, yet costly real-world demonstrations and limited access to dense process rewards hinder its practical application. We present TwinBridge, a digital twin-driven framework that supplies policy initialization and dense visual rewards for real-world online learning. We construct digital twins by combining 3D Gaussian splatting with physics simulation. Here, simulator states provide task events and geometric progress under physical prerequisites and ordering constraints, yielding rewards for policy pretraining with simulated demonstrations and reinforcement learning. We distill this supervision into a visual reward model. During real-world interaction, its predictions are combined with execution history to compute dense rewards for human-in-the-loop policy refinement. Across five real-world laboratory tasks, TwinBridge achieves a final mean autonomous success rate of 98% with at most 25 minutes of real-world interaction per task. Experiments show that dense rewards improve interaction efficiency over sparse rewards, and simulation-based policy initialization further accelerates learning.
items.abstract_zh: 在线强化学习为精确实验室操作提供了一种有效方法，但昂贵的真实世界演示以及对密集过程奖励的有限获取阻碍了其实际应用。我们提出TwinBridge，一个数字孪生驱动的框架，为真实世界在线学习提供策略初始化和密集视觉奖励。我们通过将3D高斯泼溅与物理仿真相结合来构建数字孪生。在此，仿真器状态在物理前提和顺序约束下提供任务事件和几何进度，从而产生用于使用仿真演示进行策略预训练和强化学习的奖励。我们将这种监督蒸馏为视觉奖励模型。在真实世界交互期间，其预测与执行历史相结合，以计算用于人在回路策略细化的密集奖励。在五个真实世界实验室任务中，TwinBridge在每个任务最多25分钟真实世界交互的情况下，最终平均自主成功率达到98%。实验表明，密集奖励相比稀疏奖励提高了交互效率，而基于仿真的策略初始化进一步加速了学习。

items.title_en: EDGAR: Efficient Diffusion-Driven Gaussian Avatar Refinement via Synthetic Failure
items.title_zh: EDGAR：通过合成失败实现高效扩散驱动的高斯化身细化
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in Gaussian splatting have enabled efficient and photorealistic head avatar reconstruction, yet monocular video-based or image-based methods still suffer from under-constrained geometry and texture, leading to artifacts such as blurring, stretching, and temporal instability. We present EDGAR (Efficient Diffusion-Driven Gaussian Avatar Refinement), a conditional diffusion framework designed to enhance the quality of Gaussian avatars by correcting artifacts while preserving identity fidelity. To train EDGAR, we construct EDGAR-SET, a hybrid triplet dataset composed of real-captured and synthetic-rendered samples, which simulates realistic Gaussian avatar failure cases by pairing degraded renderings with ground-truth and reference images. EDGAR refines degraded frames through a fusion block that injects identity features extracted by the self-supervised Sapiens model into a one-step diffusion backbone, enabling effective artifact removal without sacrificing efficiency. Our EDGAR model incorporates a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture to address diverse degradation types and severity levels. The refined multi-view renderings are subsequently used as pseudo-targets to optimize a single underlying Gaussian avatar, so that the final avatar can be rendered without applying EDGAR to every output frame. Experiments on three different Gaussian avatar reconstruction methods, each evaluated under three different settings, show improvements in both perceptual and reconstruction measures over the raw outputs and an SDEdit-style refinement baseline. In addition, cross-view evaluation demonstrates improved calibrated consistency, while tests under large yaw and open-mouth expressions verify robustness under extreme settings. These results collectively indicate a useful operating regime for recoverable appearance artifacts. The code is available at https://kwanyun.github.io/edgar/
items.abstract_zh: 高斯泼溅的最新进展使高效、照片级真实感的头部化身重建成为可能，但基于单目视频或图像的方法仍受几何与纹理约束不足的困扰，导致模糊、拉伸和时间不稳定等伪影。我们提出 EDGAR（高效扩散驱动高斯化身细化），一种条件扩散框架，旨在通过校正伪影同时保持身份保真度来提升高斯化身质量。为训练 EDGAR，我们构建了 EDGAR-SET，一个由真实采集样本和合成渲染样本组成的混合三元组数据集，通过将退化渲染与真值图像和参考图像配对，模拟真实的高斯化身失败案例。EDGAR 通过融合模块细化退化帧，该模块将由自监督 Sapiens 模型提取的身份特征注入一步扩散主干，从而在不牺牲效率的情况下有效去除伪影。我们的 EDGAR 模型采用专家混合（MoE）架构，以应对多样的退化类型和严重程度。细化后的多视角渲染随后被用作伪目标，以优化单个底层高斯化身，从而最终化身无需对每个输出帧应用 EDGAR 即可渲染。在三种不同的高斯化身重建方法上（每种方法在三种不同设置下评估）的实验表明，相较于原始输出和 SDEdit 风格细化基线，在感知和重建指标上均有提升。此外，跨视角评估显示出改善的校准一致性，而在大偏航角和张嘴表情下的测试验证了极端设置下的鲁棒性。这些结果共同表明，对于可恢复的外观伪影存在一个有用的工作区间。代码可在 https://kwanyun.github.io/edgar/ 获取。

items.title_en: El Agente Fármaco: A Scalable AI Scientist for Drug Discovery
items.title_zh: El Agente Fármaco：一种可扩展的药物发现 AI 科学家
items.abstract_en: Computational drug discovery offers a growing range of tools for proposing and evaluating molecules, but combining them and deciding what to do next still requires substantial expert effort. Here, we introduce El Agente Fármaco, an AI scientist that uses modern large language model (LLM) technology to turn discovery goals expressed in everyday language into complex, scalable computational screening workflows. The agentic harness selects scientific tools, reviews their results, and adjusts subsequent steps to the target and the user's objectives. Our approach centers on a shared scientific memory: Fármaco Atlas, which stores molecules, structures, and results together with their provenance -- a record of how they were obtained. The agent uses targeted database queries to retrieve the evidence needed for each decision. A single request can launch calculations for an entire collection of molecules, without requiring a separate LLM decision for every compound. This design limits the information the model must process as screening collections grow, while keeping the underlying results available for inspection and further analysis. The integrated tools support molecule generation, prediction of binding and molecular properties, and searches for compounds available for purchase. In a retrospective comparison with an expert-led campaign, the agent proposed chemically distinct candidates with competitive docking scores and higher calculated drug-likeness under explicitly imposed selection criteria. In a 22-task benchmark against plain tool calls and Codex, the agent achieved the highest observed mean model-judged score, with lower median cumulative token use and peak context. Fármaco provides a foundation for flexible, scalable drug discovery workflows that connect scientific reasoning with an enduring, traceable record of computational work.
items.abstract_zh: 计算药物发现提供了越来越多用于提出和评估分子的工具，但将它们组合起来并决定下一步做什么仍需要大量专家努力。在此，我们介绍 El Agente Fármaco，一种 AI 科学家，它利用现代大语言模型（LLM）技术，将用日常语言表达的发现目标转化为复杂、可扩展的计算筛选工作流。该智能体框架选择科学工具、审查其结果，并根据靶标和用户目标调整后续步骤。我们的方法以共享科学记忆为核心：Fármaco Atlas，它将分子、结构和结果与其来源——即它们如何获得的记录——一起存储。智能体使用有针对性的数据库查询来检索每个决策所需的证据。单个请求可以启动对整个分子集合的计算，而无需为每个化合物单独做出 LLM 决策。这种设计在筛选集合增长时限制了模型必须处理的信息量，同时保持底层结果可供检查和进一步分析。集成工具支持分子生成、结合与分子性质预测，以及可购买化合物的搜索。在与专家主导的筛选活动的回顾性比较中，该智能体在明确施加的选择标准下提出了化学上不同的候选物，其对接分数具有竞争力，计算得到的类药性更高。在针对普通工具调用和 Codex 的 22 项任务基准测试中，该智能体取得了观测到的最高平均模型评判分数，同时中位累计 token 使用量和峰值上下文更低。Fármaco 为灵活、可扩展的药物发现工作流提供了基础，将科学推理与持久、可追踪的计算工作记录连接起来。

items.title_en: Reliability of Fisher-information bounds for dielectric metalenses: a site-resolved RCWA audit
items.title_zh: 介电超透镜 Fisher 信息界的可靠性：一项位点分辨的 RCWA 审计
items.abstract_en: We assess the reliability of localization precision predicted for a 1716-nanopillar dielectric metalens using a site-resolved complex RCWA library and a vectorial Poisson Fisher model. An independent calculation reproduces the archived local axial Cramer-Rao bound of 20.7738 nm to within 0.0044 nm, yielding 20.7695 nm under the same ideal detector and 3000 detected signal photons. High-order periodic-cell calculations reveal a 0.1335 rad phase difference at a selected diameter; different substrate-index assumptions prevent attributing this difference solely to modal truncation. Replacing the recalculated coefficients at 39 actual sites changes the bound to 20.7522 nm. Restricted phase-mask benchmarks and pixel-integration checks further distinguish a stable statistical prediction from electromagnetic convergence. We provide a reproducible, model-conditional benchmark, not a physical-device performance claim.
items.abstract_zh: 我们使用位点分辨的复 RCWA 库和矢量泊松 Fisher 模型，评估对 1716 个纳米柱介电超透镜所预测定位精度的可靠性。一项独立计算将存档的局部轴向 Cramer-Rao 界 20.7738 nm 复现到 0.0044 nm 以内，在相同理想探测器和 3000 个探测信号光子下得到 20.7695 nm。高阶周期单元计算在选定直径处揭示了 0.1335 rad 的相位差；不同的衬底折射率假设使得无法将该差异仅归因于模态截断。在 39 个实际位点替换重新计算的系数后，界变为 20.7522 nm。受限相位掩模基准和像素积分检查进一步区分了稳定的统计预测与电磁收敛。我们提供的是可复现的、以模型为条件的基准，而非物理器件性能声明。

items.title_en: User Embeddings are Superpositions of Interpretable Behavioral Modes
items.title_zh: 用户嵌入是可解释行为模式的叠加
items.abstract_en: User embeddings are central components of modern recommendation, personalization, and behavioral modeling systems. Though these embeddings can compactly encode rich behavioral information, they are inherently dense and opaque, limiting interpretability. To address this gap, we argue that user embeddings can be understood as sparse superpositions of interpretable behavioral modes. This structure is directly predicted by generative models of user behavior for linear embeddings and extends approximately to deep-learning representations by the superposition hypothesis. Superimposed modes can naturally be recovered by sparse dictionary learning methods, such as sparse autoencoders (SAEs), and recovered modes can be automatically named and queried in natural language. We validate mode recovery against known ground truth on synthetic data, where SAEs recover modes better than classical sparse baselines, including on transformer-encoded embeddings. We then apply the method to classical and transformer-based user embeddings from two real-world datasets. We also show how the corresponding natural-language labels enable zero-shot audience retrieval and characterization over embeddings never trained on text. The framework is post-hoc and model-agnostic, requiring no modification to the upstream embedding system.
items.abstract_zh: 用户嵌入是现代推荐、个性化和行为建模系统的核心组成部分。尽管这些嵌入可以紧凑地编码丰富的行为信息，但它们本质上是稠密且不透明的，限制了可解释性。为弥补这一空白，我们认为用户嵌入可以理解为可解释行为模式的稀疏叠加。对于线性嵌入，这种结构由用户行为的生成模型直接预测，并通过叠加假设近似扩展到深度学习表示。叠加的模式可以通过稀疏字典学习方法自然恢复，例如稀疏自编码器（SAE），并且恢复的模式可以用自然语言自动命名和查询。我们在合成数据上根据已知真值验证模式恢复，其中 SAE 比经典稀疏基线更好地恢复模式，包括在 Transformer 编码的嵌入上。然后，我们将该方法应用于来自两个真实世界数据集的经典用户嵌入和基于 Transformer 的用户嵌入。我们还展示了相应的自然语言标签如何能够在从未用文本训练的嵌入上实现零样本受众检索和刻画。该框架是事后且模型无关的，不需要修改上游嵌入系统。

items.title_en: Loop Before You Leap: What Recurrent Depth Can and Cannot Buy in Data-Limited Pretraining
items.title_zh: Loop Before You Leap：循环深度在数据受限预训练中能带来什么与不能带来什么
items.abstract_en: Multimodal models have often scored below text-only baselines in the BabyLM Challenge (Klerings et al., 2024; Takmaz et al., 2025). We test whether additional recurrent computation helps close this gap. Recurrence increases computation by reusing layers without adding parameters or training data. Using a single implementation, we compare standard and looped Transformers under a 100M-word budget, with three seeds per main condition. Each image is represented by one feature vector from a frozen DINOv2 encoder, used as a prefix token. Caption words count toward the budget, so multimodal training also changes the language data. In a pre-registered text-only comparison, a 12-layer stack repeated four times exceeds a standard 48-layer Transformer by 5.4 BLiMP percentage points at matched inference compute. However, multimodal training lowers BLiMP accuracy by about 3.8 points in both architectures, with no clear mitigation from recurrence. An exploratory loop-side no-image control, trained with the multimodal language data and batching schedule, scores 5.7 points below the text-only baseline. Adding the visual prefix raises accuracy by 1.85 points on average, but this contrast is uncertain with three seeds. These results suggest that changes in language data and its presentation are a major source of the drop. Diagnostic tests show that the models use visual information; its contribution to grammatical generalization remains uncertain under this single-vector interface.
items.abstract_zh: 在 BabyLM 挑战赛中，多模态模型往往得分低于纯文本基线（Klerings 等，2024；Takmaz 等，2025）。我们测试额外的循环计算是否有助于缩小这一差距。循环通过复用层来增加计算量，而不增加参数或训练数据。使用单一实现，我们在 1 亿词预算下比较标准 Transformer 和循环 Transformer，每个主要条件使用三个随机种子。每张图像由来自冻结 DINOv2 编码器的一个特征向量表示，并用作前缀 token。字幕词计入预算，因此多模态训练也会改变语言数据。在一项预注册的纯文本比较中，在匹配推理计算量下，重复四次的 12 层堆叠比标准 48 层 Transformer 高出 5.4 个 BLiMP 百分点。然而，多模态训练在两种架构中都将 BLiMP 准确率降低约 3.8 个百分点，循环并未带来明显缓解。一项探索性的循环侧无图像对照，使用多模态语言数据和批处理计划训练，其得分比纯文本基线低 5.7 个百分点。添加视觉前缀平均将准确率提高 1.85 个百分点，但在三个随机种子下这一对比不确定。这些结果表明，语言数据及其呈现方式的变化是性能下降的主要来源。诊断测试表明模型确实使用了视觉信息；在这种单向量接口下，其对语法泛化的贡献仍不确定。

items.title_en: Physical Diffusion Policy via MPM-Guided 3D Gaussian Simulation
items.title_zh: 基于 MPM 引导的 3D 高斯仿真的物理扩散策略
items.abstract_en: Learning robust manipulation policies for diverse everyday objects remains challenging because objects with different materials exhibit distinct deformation and contact dynamics. While diffusion policies provide a powerful framework for modeling multimodal manipulation behaviors, they typically lack explicit physical reasoning and may produce averaged actions when facing heterogeneous objects. We present a physics-aware diffusion policy that augments visual imitation learning with object physical understanding. Our framework recovers material properties from visual demonstrations by coupling 3D Gaussian Splatting with differentiable Material Point Method simulation, where video guidance and particle-level constraints enable accurate physical parameter estimation. The estimated physics conditions are further integrated into a material-aware Mixture-of-Experts diffusion policy, allowing adaptive behavior generation across different physical regimes. For practical deployment, we introduce a physics memory bank that provides efficient physical retrieval without requiring online simulation optimization. Experiments on a wide range of simulated and real-world objects demonstrate improved manipulation success and generalization over existing diffusion-based approaches. These results show that incorporating physical knowledge is critical for scalable robot manipulation in diverse environments.
items.abstract_zh: 为多样的日常物体学习鲁棒的操作策略仍然具有挑战性，因为不同材料的物体表现出不同的变形和接触动力学。尽管扩散策略为建模多模态操作行为提供了强大框架，但它们通常缺乏显式物理推理，并且在面对异质物体时可能产生平均化动作。我们提出一种物理感知扩散策略，用物体物理理解来增强视觉模仿学习。我们的框架通过将 3D 高斯泼溅与可微物质点法（MPM）仿真耦合，从视觉演示中恢复材料属性，其中视频引导和粒子级约束使准确的物理参数估计成为可能。估计的物理条件进一步集成到材料感知的专家混合扩散策略中，从而能够在不同物理机制下自适应生成行为。为实际部署，我们引入物理记忆库，无需在线仿真优化即可提供高效的物理检索。在广泛的仿真和真实世界物体上的实验表明，相较于现有基于扩散的方法，操作成功率和泛化能力有所提高。这些结果表明，纳入物理知识对于多样环境中可扩展的机器人操作至关重要。

items.title_en: A Theoretical Analysis of a Bilevel Optimization Formulation for Combined Local-Global Optical Flow Models
items.title_zh: 组合局部-全局光流模型的双层优化表述的理论分析
items.abstract_en: This paper analyzes a bilevel formulation for learning the regularization parameter of combined local-global (CLG) optical flow models. The lower-level problem computes the flow from a Lucas--Kanade data term and a quadratic or total variation (TV) regularizer, and the upper-level problem selects the parameter that minimizes the squared distance to a ground-truth flow. The setting is finite-dimensional, and a full-rank assumption makes the lower-level solution unique. For the quadratic model we derive sufficient conditions for the existence of an optimal parameter, for every optimal parameter to be positive, and for strict local optimality. For TV regularization an optimal parameter always exists, because the lower-level solution vanishes for large parameters, and we give a sufficient condition for positivity that accounts for the coupling of the two flow components through the local structure tensors. Synthetic examples illustrate the conditions, including cases in which they fail.
items.abstract_zh: 本文分析了一种用于学习组合局部-全局（CLG）光流模型正则化参数的双层表述。下层问题根据 Lucas--Kanade 数据项和二次或全变分（TV）正则化器计算光流，上层问题选择使到真值光流的平方距离最小的参数。该设定是有限维的，并且全秩假设使下层解唯一。对于二次模型，我们推导了最优参数存在、每个最优参数均为正以及严格局部最优性的充分条件。对于 TV 正则化，最优参数总是存在，因为下层解在参数较大时消失；我们给出了一个考虑两个光流分量通过局部结构张量耦合的正性充分条件。合成示例说明了这些条件，包括它们不成立的情形。

items.title_en: In-depth data movement characterization of DNA read mapping algorithms
items.title_zh: DNA读段映射算法的深入数据移动表征
items.abstract_en: Read mapping algorithms represent a critical bottleneck in genomic analysis pipelines due to the resources required; a problem that is becoming more pronounced as sequencing technologies advance and datasets expand. We present an extensive workload characterization of leading read mapping algorithms across diverse sequencing technologies to identify hardware acceleration and optimization opportunities. We analyzed the following implementations: MashMap, wfmash, and Minimap2 for whole-genome alignment (WGA); NGMLR, Minimap2, and LRA for long reads; and Bowtie2, BWA-MEM, StrobeAlign, and minibwa for short reads. We used the Intel VTune Profiler for detailed memory analysis to identify memory- bound functions, cache usage patterns, and data transfer bottlenecks. We further analyzed a selected subset of alignment tools using the DAMOV-SIM simulator to obtain a more granular view of data movement characteristics for two different cache structures. Based on our results, Minimap2 emerges as the fastest alignment tool for long read scenarios, but falls behind in whole-genome alignment due to poor multithreading. Across all three categories, some programs (e.g., LRA, BWA-MEM) are highly memory-bound. More in-depth analysis via DAMOV-SIM revealed that some memory-bound tools, in particular, do not fully utilize the multi-level cache hierarchy in modern multi-core CPU architectures. Our results show that while some tools require algorithmic redesign for performance gains, some others can benefit from running on PIM architectures.
items.abstract_zh: 由于所需资源，读段映射算法是基因组分析流水线中的关键瓶颈；随着测序技术发展和数据集扩大，该问题正变得更加突出。我们对跨多种测序技术的主流读段映射算法进行了广泛的工作负载表征，以识别硬件加速和优化机会。我们分析了以下实现：用于全基因组比对（WGA）的 MashMap、wfmash 和 Minimap2；用于长读段的 NGMLR、Minimap2 和 LRA；以及用于短读段的 Bowtie2、BWA-MEM、StrobeAlign 和 minibwa。我们使用 Intel VTune Profiler 进行详细内存分析，以识别受内存限制的函数、缓存使用模式和数据传输瓶颈。我们进一步使用 DAMOV-SIM 模拟器分析了选定的比对工具子集，以获得针对两种不同缓存结构的数据移动特征的更细粒度视图。基于我们的结果，Minimap2 成为长读段场景中最快的比对工具，但由于多线程性能不佳，其在整个基因组比对中落后。在所有三个类别中，一些程序（例如 LRA、BWA-MEM）高度受内存限制。通过 DAMOV-SIM 进行的更深入分析揭示，一些受内存限制的工具尤其没有充分利用现代多核 CPU 架构中的多级缓存层次结构。我们的结果表明，虽然一些工具需要算法重新设计以获得性能提升，但另一些工具可以从在 PIM 架构上运行中受益。

items.title_en: Evanescent-Depth-Engineered High-Q topological Cavities for Strong Photon-Exciton Coupling
items.title_zh: 倏逝深度工程化高Q拓扑腔用于强光子-激子耦合
items.abstract_en: Due to the inherent scattering in topological edge states, the topological resonant cavity (TRC) formed by their interference exhibits a relatively low quality factor (Q). To address this issue, we propose the mechanism of engineering the transverse evanescent depth of edge states to achieve high-Q in irregular shaped TRCs, which further enables strong photon-exciton coupling at the single-quantum level. By adjusting the intra- and inter-cell coupling strengths in the pseudo-spin topological photonic crystal, the transverse evanescent depth of edge states is greatly reduced, thereby suppressing the scattering of TRCs. Consequently, the Q of various shaped TRCs with 2 ~ 3 um size is up to 10^5 ~ 10^6 in the visible, so that the strong photon-exciton coupling is achieved. The high-Q topological cavities hold promising application in integrated lasers, sensors, cavity quantum electrodynamics, and quantum photonics.
items.abstract_zh: 由于拓扑边缘态中固有的散射，由其干涉形成的拓扑谐振腔（TRC）表现出相对较低的品质因数（Q）。为解决这一问题，我们提出了对边缘态的横向倏逝深度进行工程调控的机制，以在不规则形状的 TRC 中实现高 Q，这进一步能够在单量子级实现强光子-激子耦合。通过调节赝自旋拓扑光子晶体中的元胞内和元胞间耦合强度，边缘态的横向倏逝深度被大幅降低，从而抑制 TRC 的散射。因此，尺寸为 2～3 μm 的各种形状 TRC 在可见光波段的 Q 高达 10^5～10^6，从而实现强光子-激子耦合。高 Q 拓扑腔在集成激光器、传感器、腔量子电动力学和量子光子学中具有广阔的应用前景。

items.title_en: Wireless Link Scheduling with Graph Signal Diffusion
items.title_zh: 基于图信号扩散的无线链路调度
items.abstract_en: We solve long-horizon wireless link scheduling with per-link minimum transmission constraints. Fair distribution of resources across links and time steps requires stochastic scheduling, motivating a diffusion framework. Via imitation learning, we train a diffusion model to sample scheduling decisions, conditioning generation on the network topology and constraint levels. The parameterization is achieved through a U-Graph Neural Network (U-GNN) to leverage the relationship between graphs and wireless networks for learning. Our approach achieves near-optimal performance, maximizing sum rate while distributing allocations across different links over time horizons. The U-GNN-based diffusion model generalizes to requirements and network sizes unseen during training, demonstrating the robustness of the approach.
items.abstract_zh: 我们求解具有每链路最小传输约束的长期时域无线链路调度。跨链路和时间步公平分配资源需要随机调度，这推动了扩散框架。通过模仿学习，我们训练扩散模型来采样调度决策，并以网络拓扑和约束水平为条件生成。参数化通过 U-图神经网络（U-GNN）实现，以利用图与无线网络之间的关系进行学习。我们的方法实现了接近最优的性能，在跨时间时域将分配分布到不同链路的同时最大化总速率。基于 U-GNN 的扩散模型能够泛化到训练中未见的要求和网络规模，证明了该方法的鲁棒性。
