items.title_en: Overview of the NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval Task: Cross-modal Claim Verification in Scientific Papers
items.title_zh: NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval任务概述：科学论文中的跨模态主张验证
items.abstract_en: This paper presents an overview of \emph{SciClaimEval}, a pilot task at NTCIR-19 on verifying scientific claims against the tables and figures of the papers in which they appear. Our dataset pairs authentic claims from 180 papers in machine learning, natural language processing, and medicine with contrastive versions of their tables and figures, one supporting the claim and one minimally modified so that it does not. The task comprises two subtasks: deciding whether a piece of evidence supports a claim, and selecting which of two evidence versions does. Twenty-two teams registered, the highest number among NTCIR-19 tasks, and 14 submitted 177 runs. Most systems built on multimodal large language models, relying on prompting and multi-stage inference rather than task-specific fine-tuning. On the first subtask, the best systems reached 98.1\% pair accuracy, but all six top-ranked systems relied on the contrastive pairs; the best system that judged each claim-evidence pair on its own scored 24.3 points lower. Open-weight models, embedded in carefully designed pipelines, matched proprietary ones. Yet verifying a single claim against its evidence, the setting that matters in practice, remains an open problem.
items.abstract_zh: 本文概述了 SciClaimEval，这是 NTCIR-19 的一个试点任务，旨在验证科学主张与其所在论文中的表格和图是否一致。我们的数据集将来自机器学习、自然语言处理和医学领域 180 篇论文的真实主张与其表格和图的对比版本配对：一个支持该主张，另一个经过最小修改后不支持该主张。该任务包括两个子任务：判断一条证据是否支持某项主张，以及选择两个证据版本中哪一个支持该主张。共有 22 支团队注册，是 NTCIR-19 任务中注册数量最多的，14 支团队提交了 177 次运行结果。大多数系统建立在多模态大语言模型之上，依赖提示和多阶段推理，而不是任务特定的微调。在第一个子任务上，最佳系统达到 98.1% 的成对准确率，但排名前六的系统均依赖对比对；独立判断每个主张-证据对的最佳系统得分低 24.3 分。开放权重模型嵌入精心设计的流水线后，与专有模型相当。然而，针对其证据验证单个主张——实践中重要的设定——仍是一个开放问题。

items.title_en: Radio-to-Pose Information for Gauge-Drift Correction in Cooperative Localization
items.title_zh: 用于协同定位中规范漂移校正的无线电到位姿信息
items.abstract_en: Cooperative localization uses odometry and inter-robot measurements to estimate the motion of a robot team. These measurements describe only relative geometry, but the team's estimated position and orientation can drift together over time, i.e., gauge drift. In this work, we study correction of this gauge drift using a radio attenuation map registered in the same world coordinate frame used for robot poses. Specifically, we propose Radio-to-Pose Information (RPI), an interface that converts power residuals and their pose derivatives into a Gaussian information matrix and vector pair. RPI builds on the insight that received power is sensitive to shared displacement in the world map. The pose estimator uses the interface together with odometry and inter-robot measurements to update poses and minimize uncertainty. We characterize the shared motions detectable from the map and observed links. For an uncertain shared map, RPI keeps correlations across robots and time and reproduces joint Gaussian pose estimates and covariances. Across $1000$ simulated Gaussian trials, RPI matches the results of joint estimation. Across 32 paired trials with a registered map, RPI reduces common-position RMSE from $0.542$m to $0.140$m in a $50\times50$m arena compared with a baseline that uses radio only to weight relative measurements.
items.abstract_zh: 协同定位使用里程计和机器人间测量来估计机器人团队的运动。这些测量仅描述相对几何关系，但团队估计的位置和姿态可能随时间一起漂移，即规范漂移。在这项工作中，我们研究使用配准到与机器人位姿相同世界坐标系中的无线电衰减图来校正这种规范漂移。具体而言，我们提出无线电到位姿信息（RPI），这是一种将功率残差及其位姿导数转换为高斯信息矩阵和向量对的接口。RPI 基于以下洞见：接收功率对世界地图中的共享位移敏感。位姿估计器将该接口与里程计和机器人间测量结合使用，以更新位姿并最小化不确定性。我们表征了可从地图和观测链路中检测到的共享运动。对于不确定的共享地图，RPI 保留跨机器人和时间的相关性，并复现联合高斯位姿估计和协方差。在 1000 次模拟高斯试验中，RPI 与联合估计的结果相匹配。在配准地图的 32 次配对试验中，与仅使用无线电对相对测量进行加权的基线相比，RPI 在 50×50 m 的场地中将公共位置 RMSE 从 0.542 m 降至 0.140 m。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Reviving the Discarded High-Resolution Feature for Transformer-Based Tiny Object Detection
items.title_zh: 重新启用被丢弃的高分辨率特征用于基于Transformer的微小目标检测
items.abstract_en: Tiny object detection remains challenging because tiny instances occupy only a few pixels, and their fine-grained details are easily lost during feature downsampling. Although the highest-resolution feature preserves rich local details for tiny objects, DETR-like detectors often discard it due to its large computational cost, while directly reintroducing this feature also brings dense background noise. To address this problem, we propose ReDHF, a novel framework that Revives the Discarded High-resolution Feature for tiny object detection. ReDHF has three cooperative components. Cross-Scale Deformable Fusion (CSDF) first constructs a semantically enhanced highest-resolution feature and injects its fine-grained details into the shallow feature under a moderate cost. Ellipse-Guided Shallow Supervision (EGSS) then guides the enhanced feature to learn more reliable classification and localization priors by applying geometry-adaptive auxiliary supervision. Full-Scale Query Interaction (FSQI) further enables decoder queries to access both low-level details and high-level semantic information, allowing them to aggregate richer cues for tiny objects. Extensive experiments show that ReDHF consistently improves multiple baselines across different DETR variants and achieves state-of-the-art performance on the evaluated benchmarks. The best ReDHF variants surpass their baselines by +1.4 AP on AI-TOD-v2, +1.6 AP on VisDrone, and +1.5 AP on SODA-D, with especially notable gains on tiny and small objects.
items.abstract_zh: 微小目标检测仍具挑战性，因为微小实例仅占据少量像素，其细粒度细节在特征下采样过程中容易丢失。尽管最高分辨率特征保留了微小目标丰富的局部细节，但类DETR检测器常因其计算代价大而将其丢弃，而直接重新引入该特征也会带来密集的背景噪声。为解决该问题，我们提出ReDHF，一种用于微小目标检测的新框架，可重新启用被丢弃的高分辨率特征（Revives the Discarded High-resolution Feature）。ReDHF包含三个协同组件。跨尺度可变形融合（CSDF）首先构建语义增强的最高分辨率特征，并在适中代价下将其细粒度细节注入浅层特征。椭圆引导浅层监督（EGSS）随后通过应用几何自适应辅助监督，引导增强特征学习更可靠分类与定位先验。全尺度查询交互（FSQI）进一步使解码器查询能够同时访问低层细节和高层语义信息，从而为微小目标聚合更丰富线索。大量实验表明，ReDHF在不同DETR变体上持续改进多个基线，并在所评估基准上达到最先进性能。最佳ReDHF变体在AI-TOD-v2上超过其基线+1.4 AP，在VisDrone上+1.6 AP，在SODA-D上+1.5 AP，在微小和小目标上增益尤显著。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为检测与跟踪，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Modeling Visual Cortex with Layerwise Multiscale Manifold Capacity Maximization
items.title_zh: 以逐层多尺度流形容量最大化建模视觉皮层
items.abstract_en: Task-optimized deep neural networks have risen to prominence as the most predictive phenomenological models of responses in primate visual cortex, but leave much to be desired from the perspective of biological plausibility. One such limitation is the reliance on precise credit assignment through global backpropagation of error signals. Recent work has shown that this weakness can be circumvented by requiring each subsequent stage to solve a distinct and increasingly complex task, allowing for layerwise local learning signals. We propose a novel strategy for crafting such intermediate losses that uses an efficient coding framework formulated in terms of manifold capacity, and which can be computed using a sequence of {canonical cortical computations}. In particular, we leverage the relationship between the multiscale nature of visual signals and the dilation of receptive field sizes in cascaded visual representations to modulate complexity, allowing for the reapplication of these common loss computations at each stage of the hierarchy. We evaluate our approach on its ability to predict neural datasets spanning three areas of the ventral stream hierarchy in macaques, as well as human psychophysical data on an object classification task. We find that our unsupervised layerwise model matches or exceeds the performance of competitive architecture-matched baselines on all evaluations considered.
items.abstract_zh: 任务优化的深度神经网络已成为预测灵长类视觉皮层反应的最具预测力的现象学模型，但从生物合理性角度看仍有很多不足。其中一个局限是依赖通过误差信号的全局反向传播进行精确的信用分配。近期工作表明，可以通过要求每个后续阶段解决一个不同且逐渐复杂的任务来规避这一弱点，从而允许逐层的局部学习信号。我们提出一种构造此类中间损失的新策略，该策略使用以流形容量表述的高效编码框架，并可通过一系列{典型皮层计算}来计算。特别地，我们利用视觉信号的多尺度性质与级联视觉表示中感受野尺寸扩张之间的关系来调制复杂度，使这些常见损失计算可在层级结构的每个阶段重复应用。我们在预测覆盖猕猴腹侧通路层级三个区域的神经数据集，以及人类在物体分类任务上的心理物理学数据上评估我们的方法。我们发现，我们的无监督逐层模型在所有考虑的评价中达到或超过有竞争力的架构匹配基线。

items.title_en: BIC-Engineered Silicon Nitride Microring Resonators Enabled by an Etch-Free Laser-Writing Approach
items.title_zh: 免刻蚀激光写入方法实现的BIC工程氮化硅微环谐振器
items.abstract_en: We report the initial experimental demonstration of a complementary, etch-free approach with fewer fabrication steps, in useful SU-8 ridges written by direct ultraviolet laser lithography on an unpatterned silicon nitride film define waveguides and microring resonators. Because the nitride film is never patterned, scattering at patterned nitride sidewalls does not arise, and the remaining radiative loss is engineered by design. The guided transverse-magnetic mode lies within the continuum of transverse-electric slab modes, and we use bound states in the continuum (BICs) as a design tool to control this radiation. Coupled-mode analysis and full-vectorial simulations show that radiation from the two ridge sidewalls cancels by destructive interference at discrete widths, with a first BIC at 2.25 micron and radiation below 1 dB/cm over a 0.3 micron width window and about 200 nm of bandwidth, and that curvature confines this cancellation to discrete bands of bending radius and width. Laser-written waveguides follow the predicted width dependence of the loss, reaching approximately 1.5 dB/cm near the BIC, where non-radiative loss dominates. A microring designed on a radius-selected BIC band exhibits loaded quality factors up to 1.6 \times 10^4 and, under the over-coupled assignment supported by a coupler model, an intrinsic quality factor of 3.3 \times 10^5. Because radiation is set by a patterned low-index layer on an unetched film, the same approach could be extended to other nanostructures. Optimization of the writing conditions and materials is ongoing.
items.abstract_zh: 我们首次实验演示了一种互补的、无需刻蚀且制造步骤更少的方法：在未图形化氮化硅薄膜上通过直接紫外激光光刻写入的可用的SU-8脊定义了波导和微环谐振器。由于氮化物薄膜从未被图形化，不会产生图形化氮化物侧壁处的散射，剩余辐射损耗通过设计进行调控。导模横磁模位于横电平板模的连续谱内，我们使用连续谱中的束缚态（BIC）作为设计工具来控制这种辐射。耦合模分析和全矢量仿真表明，来自两个脊侧壁的辐射在离散宽度处通过相消干涉而抵消，首个BIC位于2.25微米，在0.3微米宽度窗口和约200 nm带宽内辐射低于1 dB/cm，并且曲率将该抵消限制在弯曲半径和宽度的离散带内。激光写入波导遵循预测的损耗随宽度变化关系，在BIC附近达到约1.5 dB/cm，该处非辐射损耗占主导。在半径选择的BIC带上设计的微环表现出高达1.6×10^4的负载品质因数，并在耦合器模型支持的过耦合设定下，具有3.3×10^5的本征品质因数。由于辐射由未刻蚀薄膜上的图形化低折射率层设定，同一方法可扩展到其他纳米结构。写入条件和材料的优化仍在进行中。

items.title_en: Invariance before structure: two modes of emergent compression in representation learning
items.title_zh: 结构之前的不变性：表示学习中涌现压缩的两种模式
items.abstract_en: Learned representations show striking invariance across biological and artificial neural networks, with different substrates and variations driven by drift, heterogeneity and initialisation. To understand this invariance, we propose Emergent Adaptive Representation Learning (EARL), a framework that distinguishes two modes of emergence in learned representations: state-space compression, where a learned representation gains predictive power over its own future beyond what the network's units can predict individually, and parameter-space compression, where networks with different micro-level parameters converge to the same representation. We formalise both as Fisher sensitivities and introduce ensemble-level information-theoretic measures for each. In a recurrent reservoir with a trained bottleneck, parameter-space compression rises within the first few epochs of training and partly independently of the task, whereas state-space compression rises about 30 epochs later and only when the network begins to learn the temporal structure of the task. These results suggest that invariance to the substrate and task-specific emergent structure are acquired in distinct phases of learning.
items.abstract_zh: 学习到的表示在生物和人工神经网络中表现出显著的不变性，其基底不同，并由漂移、异质性和初始化驱动变化。为理解这种不变性，我们提出涌现自适应表示学习（EARL）框架，该框架区分学习表示中涌现的两种模式：状态空间压缩，即学习到的表示对其自身未来获得超出网络单元单独所能预测的预测能力；以及参数空间压缩，即具有不同微观参数的网络收敛到相同表示。我们将二者形式化为Fisher敏感度，并为每个引入集成层面的信息论度量。在带有训练瓶颈的循环储备池中，参数空间压缩在训练最初几个epoch内上升，且部分独立于任务，而状态空间压缩约在30个epoch后上升，并且仅在网络开始学习任务的时间结构时出现。这些结果表明，对基底的独立性和任务特定的涌现结构是在学习的不同阶段获得的。

items.title_en: Robots in the City: Persona-Based Perceptions of Urban Robots
items.title_zh: 城市中的机器人：基于人格设定的城市机器人感知
items.abstract_en: Pedestrians increasingly encounter robots in urban public spaces without interacting with them, but how robots change the perceived safety of a street remains unclear. We examine how robot presence and type affect perceived safety across urban contexts. We generate 18 images of Seoul streets that vary in time of day, road class, and robot condition (no robot, a delivery robot, or a humanoid). Two multimodal large language models (MLLMs), Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma4-26B, each conditioned on 500 synthetic personas, choose the safer image in each pair, and 25 human respondents complete the same task. Both models prefer streets without robots and favor the delivery robot over the humanoid. Robots are chosen more often at night and less often by older personas, whereas road class has smaller effects. In the model rationales, the delivery robot appears as a physical obstacle, whereas the humanoid appears as either a threat or a source of protection. Like humans, both models chose robots more often at night, but chose the humanoid over the delivery robot far less often, and Gemma showed a night effect for the humanoid about three times that of humans. These results show that the effect of a robot on perceived safety depends on when it appears, and that persona-conditioned MLLMs capture only part of human judgments.
items.abstract_zh: 行人在城市公共空间中越来越常遇到机器人而不与其交互，但机器人如何改变街道的感知安全性仍不清楚。我们考察机器人的存在和类型如何在城市情境中影响感知安全性。我们生成18张首尔街道图像，这些图像在一天中的时间、道路类别和机器人条件（无机器人、配送机器人或人形机器人）上有所不同。两个多模态大语言模型（MLLM），Qwen3.8-27B和Gemma4-26B，分别以500个合成人格为条件，在每对图像中选择更安全的图像，25名人类受访者完成相同任务。两个模型都偏好没有机器人的街道，且更偏好配送机器人而非人形机器人。机器人在夜间更常被选择，并且更少被年长人格选择，而道路类别影响较小。在模型理由中，配送机器人表现为物理障碍，而人形机器人表现为威胁或保护来源。与人类一样，两个模型在夜间更常选择机器人，但选择人形机器人而非配送机器人的频率远低，Gemma对人形机器人的夜间效应约为人类的三倍。这些结果表明，机器人对感知安全的影响取决于其出现的时间，且以人格为条件的MLLM仅捕获人类判断的一部分。

items.title_en: An Integrated Open-Source Stack for Vision-Based Autonomous Navigation of Wheeled Rovers
items.title_zh: 用于轮式漫游车视觉自主导航的集成开源栈
items.abstract_en: Vision-based rover autonomy requires integrating perception, localization, planning and platform-specific control under limited sensing and computing resources. We present an open-source ROS 2 stack for following directional arrows, reaching a terminal cone and returning autonomously to the start. It connects YOLOv8n detection and geometric direction, range and bearing estimation with RGB-D SLAM, wheel-inertial state estimation, kinematics-aware planning, behavior-tree mission management and STM32 actuation. Standard interfaces separate reusable autonomy from the hardware layer; a proportional path-following plugin supports low-speed rover motion. Public resources include software, configuration, a labeled dataset, trained weights and evaluation logs. On 478 held-out images, the detector achieves mAP@0.5 of 0.720 under the Ultralytics evaluator and outperforms a classical OpenCV baseline under a shared evaluation protocol. The reported perception latency is 25 ms on a Jetson Orin NX. Three missions, one indoor and two outdoor, demonstrate marker-guided navigation and autonomous return without operator motion commands or reported collisions. Field results document integration failures and corrective choices; repeated instrumented trials remain necessary to quantify physical navigation errors and reliability.
items.abstract_zh: 基于视觉的漫游车自主性需要在有限的传感和计算资源下集成感知、定位、规划和平台特定控制。我们提出一个开源ROS 2栈，用于跟随方向箭头、到达终点锥标并自主返回起点。它将YOLOv8n检测与几何方向、距离和方位估计，与RGB-D SLAM、轮式惯性状态估计、运动学感知规划、行为树任务管理和STM32执行连接起来。标准接口将可复用自主性与硬件层分离；比例路径跟随插件支持低速漫游车运动。公开资源包括软件、配置、标注数据集、训练权重和评估日志。在478张留出图像上，检测器在Ultralytics评估器下达到0.720的mAP@0.5，并在共享评估协议下优于经典OpenCV基线。所报告的感知延迟在Jetson Orin NX上为25 ms。三次任务（一次室内、两次室外）展示了标记引导导航和自主返回，无需操作员运动指令，且未报告碰撞。现场结果记录了集成故障和纠正选择；仍需重复的仪器化试验来量化物理导航误差和可靠性。

items.title_en: InnerLogic-Surg: An Open Surgical Foundation Model via Continual Pretraining
items.title_zh: InnerLogic-Surg：通过持续预训练构建的开放式手术基础模型
items.abstract_en: Vision foundation models are the backbone of modern surgical image analysis, yet most surgical systems still rely on encoders pretrained on natural images or on specialist models trained from scratch on comparatively small datasets. Pretraining encoders on large amounts of surgery-specific data has the potential to generally enhance the performance of surgical image analysis methods simply by providing stronger backbones. Here we present InnerLogic-Surg, an open family of surgical vision encoders (21M--300M parameters) obtained by continually pretraining a transformer-based image encoder on millions of surgical images curated from 11,965 internet-sourced surgical videos spanning ~2,900 hours and more than fifteen procedure types. Our training recipe inherits DINOv3's pretraining stage to preserve representation ability after surgical adaptation, and additionally applies a learned feature-upsampling module for high-resolution dense prediction at low token cost. Across a benchmark covering workflow, instrument and anatomy recognition, segmentation, detection, and monocular depth, under the same architecture, the largest InnerLogic-Surg model achieves the best linear-probe performance in all 20 surgical tasks. We demonstrate that surgical continual pretraining yields transferable representations that generalize across procedures, anatomical regions, and task types, showing our surgical image encoders as a promising and scalable alternative to the procedure-specific representation learning approaches that have traditionally dominated surgical computer vision.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉基础模型是现代手术图像分析的骨干，但大多数手术系统仍依赖在自然图像上预训练的编码器，或在相对较小的数据集上从零训练的专用模型。在大量手术专用数据上预训练编码器，有可能仅通过提供更强的骨干网络，就普遍提升手术图像分析方法的性能。在此，我们提出 InnerLogic-Surg，一个开放的手术视觉编码器系列（21M–300M 参数），其通过在数百万张手术图像上持续预训练一个基于 transformer 的图像编码器而获得；这些图像整理自 11,965 段来自互联网的手术视频，涵盖约 2,900 小时和超过十五种手术类型。我们的训练方案继承了 DINOv3 的预训练阶段，以在手术适配后保持表征能力，并额外应用一个可学习的特征上采样模块，以低 token 代价实现高分辨率稠密预测。在一个涵盖工作流、器械与解剖识别、分割、检测和单目深度的基准上，在相同架构下，最大的 InnerLogic-Surg 模型在所有 20 项手术任务中取得最佳的线性探测性能。我们证明，手术持续预训练产生可迁移的表征，可泛化到不同手术、解剖区域和任务类型，表明我们的手术图像编码器是传统上主导手术计算机视觉的特定手术表征学习方法的一种有前景且可扩展的替代方案。

items.title_en: Mapping the THESEUS1 interactome links cell wall integrity and stress signalling in Arabidopsis
items.title_zh: 绘制 THESEUS1 相互作用组图谱将拟南芥中的细胞壁完整性与胁迫信号传导联系起来
items.abstract_en: The receptor kinase THESEUS1 (THE1) activates responses to impairment of cell wall integrity (CWI). However, the interaction partners enabling THE1 to mediate the responses remain underexplored, impeding a mechanistic understanding of THE1. We produced a set of THE1 GFP fusion constructs in which THE1 is either wild type, mutated in its kinase domain, has a loss of function mutation in its ectodomain, or lacks the kinase or extracellular domain. We used these constructs to perform localization studies and immunoprecipitation liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry under control and stress conditions (isoxaben induced cell wall damage and sorbitol induced hyperosmotic stress) to identify the THE1 interactome. The interactome of THE1 changed in a context dependent manner, linking THE1 to known signaling components in CWI maintenance and phytohormone response (such as proton pumps, calcium pumps, other receptor kinases or cellulose synthesis regulators). Moreover, we identified novel interactors, associating THE1 with hitherto unexplored signaling pathways in response to CWI impairment. Our results also suggest that the THE1G37D protein (corresponding to the the1 1 allele) is retained in the endoplasmic reticulum, explaining its loss of function phenotype. The THE1 interactome and localization data provide the foundation to build a mechanistic understanding of THE1 mediated CWI maintenance.
items.abstract_zh: 受体激酶 THESEUS1（THE1）激活对细胞壁完整性（CWI）受损的响应。然而，使 THE1 得以介导这些响应的相互作用伙伴仍未得到充分探索，阻碍了对 THE1 的机制性理解。我们构建了一组 THE1 GFP 融合构建体，其中 THE1 为野生型、在其激酶结构域发生突变、在其胞外结构域存在功能缺失突变，或缺失激酶结构域或胞外结构域。我们利用这些构建体，在对照和胁迫条件下（isoxaben 诱导的细胞壁损伤和山梨醇诱导的高渗胁迫）进行定位研究和免疫沉淀液相色谱串联质谱，以鉴定 THE1 相互作用组。THE1 的相互作用组以情境依赖的方式发生变化，将 THE1 与 CWI 维持和植物激素响应中的已知信号组分（如质子泵、钙泵、其他受体激酶或纤维素合成调控因子）联系起来。此外，我们鉴定了新的相互作用伙伴，将 THE1 与迄今未探索的响应 CWI 受损的信号通路联系起来。我们的结果还表明，THE1G37D 蛋白（对应于 the1-1 等位基因）滞留于内质网，这解释了其功能缺失表型。THE1 相互作用组和定位数据为建立对 THE1 介导的 CWI 维持的机制性理解提供了基础。

items.title_en: Reading Why: Born-Measured Attention with Exact Word Evidence on Light and Qubits
items.title_zh: 解读“为什么”：以精确的词证据在光学与量子比特上实现 Born 测量的注意力
items.abstract_en: When a language model answers, we can usually only estimate why. We build a transformer in which every step is a Born measurement - attention $|\langle q|k\rangle|^4$ normalised over each row, a measured product in place of the feed-forward nonlinearity, and a Born readout. With its denominators held at their values for the input, each class probability is a polynomial in the word amplitudes, so its integrated-gradient evidence is computed by a finite quadrature with no quadrature error: the words' contributions sum to the class probability above its no-information share, to $10^{-11}$ or better. On e-SNLI natural language inference, with about 98k parameters outside the embedding, the model reaches $76.98 \pm 0.17$% test accuracy, level with a softmax transformer of the same size ($76.62 \pm 0.36$%). Deleting the word its evidence ranks first changes the answer in 45% of test pairs, out of the 53% any single deletion can change, against 32% for the softmax model explained the same way and 40% by its attention x gradient. Attention can look as much like the words annotators highlighted as the evidence does, yet accounts for the answer less well: deleting the word it ranks first changes the Born Transformer's answer in 32% of pairs. The same weights compile exactly to optoelectronic optics and to qubits, and a coherent attention layer becomes one circuit equal to the model (852 CNOTs on 23 qubits). On IBM's ibm_kingston, reading only the attention overlaps by Hadamard tests, the device gave the model's answers, also when a word was deleted. With calibration circuits as deep as the overlaps, each word's evidence with the device's attention row sums followed the exact evidence (correlations 0.997 and 0.932 on two pairs chosen in advance); where a pair's evidence is a small total of large opposite terms the earlier runs say it does not, and we say why.
items.abstract_zh: 当语言模型给出答案时，我们通常只能估计其原因。我们构建了一个 transformer，其中每一步都是一次 Born 测量——注意力 $|\langle q|k\rangle|^4$ 按行归一化，用一个测量得到的乘积代替前馈非线性，以及一个 Born 读出。当分母保持为输入对应的取值时，每个类别概率都是词振幅的多项式，因此其积分梯度证据可由有限求积计算，且无求积误差：词的贡献之和等于类别概率超出其无信息份额的部分，精度达到 $10^{-11}$ 或更好。在 e-SNLI 自然语言推理任务上，嵌入之外的参数约为 98k，模型达到 $76.98 \pm 0.17$% 的测试准确率，与同等大小的 softmax transformer（$76.62 \pm 0.36$%）相当。删除其证据排名第一的词，会在 45% 的测试句对中改变答案，而任何单次删除最多能改变 53%；以同样方式解释的 softmax 模型为 32%，其注意力×梯度为 40%。注意力可以看起来与证据一样接近标注者高亮的词，但对答案的解释力较差：删除其排名第一的词，会改变 Born Transformer 在 32% 的句对中的答案。相同的权重可精确编译为光电子光学系统和量子比特，一个相干注意力层成为一个等同于该模型的电路（23 个量子比特上的 852 个 CNOT 门）。在 IBM 的 ibm_kingston 上，仅通过 Hadamard 测试读取注意力重叠，该设备给出了模型的答案，在删除一个词时也是如此。在与重叠电路同样深度的校准电路下，每个词在使用设备注意力行和时的证据与精确证据相符（在两个预先选定的句对上相关系数分别为 0.997 和 0.932）；当某个句对的证据是大量相反项的小总和时，早前的运行表明并非如此，我们解释了原因。

items.title_en: Spectral symmetry fingerprints in equivariant representations
items.title_zh: 等变表征中的谱对称性指纹
items.abstract_en: Symmetry governs the organization of physical structures, while symmetry breaking reveals their transformations. In geometric deep learning, symmetry imposes rank constraints on equivariant representations, limiting the expressive capacity of equivariant graph neural networks (GNNs). Here we show that these constraints can instead be exploited: the singular-value spectra of equivariant representations provide a unified fingerprint of structural symmetry. We introduce spectral symmetry fingerprints (SymFP), which enable discrete point-group identification through rank-template matching and continuous symmetry analysis by quantifying spectral energy beyond target rank constraints. SymFP is orientation invariant and architecture agnostic, enabling a parameter-free GNN implementation. Its spectra can be reused across multiple target groups, and the resulting leakage scores satisfy subgroup monotonicity. Across synthetic structures, molecules, coordination complexes and large biological assemblies, SymFP accurately identifies point groups, tracks controlled symmetry breaking and reveals local and degree-resolved symmetry changes that can be obscured by global geometric measures. These results establish the spectral structure of equivariant representations as a general framework for characterizing symmetry across physical systems.
items.abstract_zh: 对称性支配着物理结构的组织，而对称性破缺揭示其变换。在几何深度学习中，对称性对等变表征施加秩约束，限制了等变图神经网络（GNN）的表达能力。在此我们表明，这些约束反而可以被利用：等变表征的奇异值谱提供了结构对称性的统一指纹。我们引入谱对称性指纹（SymFP），其通过秩模板匹配实现离散点群识别，并通过量化超出目标秩约束的谱能量实现连续对称性分析。SymFP 具有方向不变性且与架构无关，可实现无参数的 GNN 实现。其谱可跨多个目标群复用，所得的泄漏分数满足子群单调性。在合成结构、分子、配位配合物和大型生物组装体上，SymFP 能准确识别点群、追踪受控的对称性破缺，并揭示可能被全局几何度量所掩盖的局部和按阶分辨的对称性变化。这些结果确立了等变表征的谱结构作为刻画跨物理系统对称性的通用框架。

items.title_en: TraceRouter++: Causal Semantic Routing Realignment via Optimal Transport
items.title_zh: TraceRouter++：通过最优传输的因果语义路由重对齐
items.abstract_en: Despite their remarkable capabilities, large foundation models (LFMs) remain susceptible to adversarial manipulation. Current safety intervention methods primarily rely on the \textit{locality hypothesis}, rigidly suppressing isolated neurons or features. However, harmful semantics manifest as distributed, cross-layer circuits, rendering localized ablations both brittle against complex jailbreaks and detrimental to general utility. To bridge this gap, we propose TraceRouter++, a routing-level safety intervention framework that explicitly traces safety-relevant causal routing pathways activated under harmful inputs and realigns their unsafe activation states. Our framework operates in a \textit{Discover-Trace-Realign} paradigm: it first pinpoints a sensitive onset layer via attention divergence and disentangles dense activations into interpretable routing features using sparse autoencoders (SAEs). Subsequently, it maps these features to downstream causal circuits via feature influence scores (FIS). Crucially, departing from rigid suppression paradigms, TraceRouter++ introduces a constrained optimal transport (OT)-based soft routing realignment. By formulating safety intervention as a tractable coordinate-wise marginal optimal transport approximation, our method redirects unsafe activation marginals toward safe-reference marginals within causally identified routing subspaces while preserving non-selected coordinates at the intervention point. This mechanism safely redirects malicious semantic flows while leaving orthogonal computational routes intact. Extensive experiments across representative large language models (LLMs), multimodal large language models (MLLMs), and diffusion models (DMs) show that TraceRouter++ outperforms evaluated baselines, improving adversarial robustness while maintaining a favorable safety-utility trade-off. WARNING: This paper contains unsafe model responses.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管大基础模型（LFM）能力卓越，但仍易受对抗性操纵的影响。当前的安全干预方法主要依赖局部性假设，刚性抑制孤立的神经元或特征。然而，有害语义表现为分布式的跨层回路，这使得局部消融既对复杂越狱攻击脆弱，又有损于通用效用。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 TraceRouter++，一个路由层面的安全干预框架，其显式追踪在有害输入下激活的、与安全相关的因果路由通路，并重对齐其不安全的激活状态。我们的框架以“发现—追踪—重对齐”（Discover-Trace-Realign）范式运行：首先通过注意力散度定位敏感的起始层，并使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）将稠密激活解耦为可解释的路由特征。随后，它通过特征影响分数（FIS）将这些特征映射到下游因果回路。关键的是，TraceRouter++ 摒弃刚性抑制范式，引入基于约束最优传输（OT）的软路由重对齐。通过将安全干预表述为可处理的坐标级边际最优传输近似，我们的方法在因果识别的路由子空间内将不安全的激活边际导向安全参考边际，同时在干预点保留未选中的坐标。该机制安全地重定向恶意语义流，同时保持正交的计算路径不变。在代表性大语言模型（LLM）、多模态大语言模型（MLLM）和扩散模型（DM）上的大量实验表明，TraceRouter++ 优于所评估的基线，在提高对抗鲁棒性的同时保持有利的安全—效用权衡。警告：本文包含不安全的模型回复。

items.title_en: Unified Overview of Safety Certificate Functions: Techniques from Hamilton--Jacobi Reachability and Control Barrier Functions
items.title_zh: 安全证书函数统一综述：来自 Hamilton–Jacobi 可达性与控制屏障函数的技术
items.abstract_en: Safety is a central concern in modern autonomous systems. Safety certificates---functions whose existence guarantees that a system meets its safety specification---have long been used as a principled tool for rigorously reasoning about safety. Methods for synthesizing such certificates are scattered across research areas, with little guidance on when to use a particular approach. This tutorial provides a holistic treatment of safety certificate synthesis centered on two widely used families: Hamilton--Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis and control barrier functions (CBFs). For each family of methods, we first introduce its general formulation, along with classical and learning-based tools for certificate synthesis. Next, we introduce two benchmark problems consisting of vehicle systems of differing complexity to assess the certificate quality of different synthesis methods and their effectiveness in safety-critical control. We use these benchmarks to compare various methods and provide practical guidance for selecting an approach.
items.abstract_zh: 安全是现代自主系统的核心关切。安全证书——其存在可保证系统满足其安全规格的函数——长期以来被用作严格推理安全性的原理性工具。合成此类证书的方法分散于各个研究领域，关于何时使用某种特定方法鲜有指导。本教程以两个广泛使用的方法族为中心，对安全证书合成进行整体性论述：Hamilton–Jacobi（HJ）可达性分析与控制屏障函数（CBF）。对于每个方法族，我们首先介绍其一般表述，以及用于证书合成的经典工具和基于学习的工具。接着，我们介绍两个由复杂度不同的车辆系统组成的基准问题，用以评估不同合成方法的证书质量及其在安全关键控制中的有效性。我们利用这些基准比较各种方法，并为选择方法提供实用指导。

items.title_en: FlyingDrones: A Dataset and Benchmark for Optical Flow Estimation from UAV motion
items.title_zh: FlyingDrones：基于无人机运动的光流估计数据集与基准
items.abstract_en: Optical flow is an important cue for drone analysis in aerial surveillance, airspace monitoring, and long-range target tracking, where motion remains informative when appearance is weak. Estimating the motion of small Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, however, is difficult because distant targets occupy few pixels, have low contrast, and move against complex dynamic backgrounds. Standard optical-flow benchmarks emphasize large, object-centric motions and therefore do not characterize distant aerial targets well. We introduce FlyingDrones, a generated benchmark with dense ground-truth optical flow and segmentation masks derived from physically based rendering, and define resolution-normalized metrics (EPE Norm) that normalize flow by image dimensions. We evaluate 16 state-of-the-art model families on a motion- and size-stratified subset of 999 flow pairs at three resolutions. Every family recovers drone motion better than the zero-flow reference, but the gap between families widens with resolution: at 1920x1080, global-matching, recurrent, transformer, and short-window temporal models separate clearly from pyramid, classical, self-supervised, lightweight, and diffusion models. Within-family checkpoint spread is comparable to or larger than between-family spread, so the training curriculum is as important as the architecture. Two complementary studies test the benchmark beyond synthetic accuracy: a ground-truth-free motion-alignment evaluation on 21 cameras of real UAV footage shows that the synthetic ranking carries a moderate, significant signal about real-world performance (Spearman \r{ho} = 0.63 over 41 checkpoints) while the exact top ranks differ, and a fine-tuning study shows that 800 FlyingDrones pairs reduce held-out drone-region error by up to 37% and improve drone localization on the real footage for all four architectures tested.
items.abstract_zh: 光流是空中监视、空域监控和远距离目标跟踪中无人机分析的重要线索；在这些场景中，当外观信息较弱时，运动信息仍具有信息量。然而，估计小型无人机的运动很困难，因为远处目标仅占少量像素、对比度低，并且在复杂动态背景中运动。标准光流基准强调大型的、以物体为中心的运动，因此不能很好地刻画远处空中目标。我们提出FlyingDrones，一个基于物理渲染生成的基准，带有稠密真值光流和分割掩码，并定义按图像尺寸对光流进行归一化的分辨率归一化指标（EPE Norm）。我们在三种分辨率下、按运动和尺寸分层选取的999对光流子集上评估了16个最先进模型家族。每个模型家族都比零光流参考更好地恢复无人机运动，但家族之间的差距随分辨率增大而扩大：在1920x1080下，全局匹配、循环、Transformer和短窗口时序模型明显区别于金字塔、经典、自监督、轻量级和扩散模型。家族内检查点间的差异与家族间差异相当或更大，因此训练课程与架构同样重要。两项互补研究在合成精度之外测试该基准：对21台真实无人机视频相机进行的无真值运动对齐评估显示，合成排名对真实世界性能带有中等且显著的信号（在41个检查点上Spearman ρ = 0.63），而精确的顶端排名有所不同；一项微调研究表明，800对FlyingDrones数据可将留出的无人机区域误差最多降低37%，并在所有测试的四种架构上改善真实视频中的无人机定位。

items.title_en: Persistent hippocampal traces of lifelong spatial memory
items.title_zh: 终生空间记忆的海马持久痕迹
items.abstract_en: Memory presents a biological paradox: the brain changes continuously, yet a brief experience can influence behavior for a lifetime. How such memories are stored in brain circuits remains unclear. Here we show that two days in a binary-tree maze leave mice with spatial memories that survive repeated 90-day absences over as much as a year. Across return visits, mice explored the maze more efficiently than when naive and resumed direct runs to a reward location sooner, both by a factor of 3. Chronic calcium imaging of the same hippocampal CA1 neurons showed that although most neurons had changed their preferred locations, the population activity at a given maze location still resembled the pattern from 90 days earlier. Furthermore, even when a neuron's place fields changed location, they tended to remain at the same branching level of the binary tree, reflecting the local geometry of the maze. In return sessions where the neural tuning for branching level was preserved more accurately, the mouse explored the environment more efficiently. Population patterns were best preserved near the reward location, and more reliable neural activity there accompanied earlier direct runs to the reward. With repeated experience, spatial representations changed less, both within a visit and across the long absences. A brief experience thus left selective hippocampal traces that survived months of absence despite drift, grew more durable with each return, and were correlated with memory in navigation behavior.
items.abstract_zh: 记忆呈现一个生物学悖论：大脑持续变化，但一次短暂经历却能终生影响行为。此类记忆如何存储于脑回路仍不清楚。在此我们表明，在二叉树迷宫中两天经历使小鼠形成空间记忆，这些记忆在长达一年的时间里经历多次90天缺席后仍能保留。在多次回访中，小鼠探索迷宫比初次更高效，并更早恢复直达奖励位置的奔跑，二者均提高3倍。对相同海马CA1神经元的慢性钙成像显示，尽管大多数神经元改变了偏好位置，但在给定迷宫位置处的群体活动仍类似于90天前的模式。此外，即使神经元的位置野改变了位置，它们也倾向于停留在二叉树同一分支层级，反映迷宫的局部几何结构。在分支层级的神经调谐保存得更准确的回访阶段，小鼠探索环境更高效。群体模式在奖励位置附近保存得最好，该处更可靠的神经活动伴随更早的直达奖励奔跑。随着重复经历，空间表征的变化更小，无论是在一次访问内还是跨越长期缺席。因此，一次短暂经历留下了选择性海马痕迹，这些痕迹尽管发生漂移，仍在数月缺席后存留，并随每次回访变得更持久，且与导航行为中的记忆相关。

items.title_en: Noise-Induced Topology in Chiral Quantum Walks
items.title_zh: 手性量子行走中噪声诱导的拓扑
items.abstract_en: Noise typically destroys quantum coherence and washes out transport phenomena that rely on interference. Chiral quantum walks are a case in point: a particle hopping on a lattice threaded by a magnetic flux can spread asymmetrically due to interference between paths, an asymmetry that noise is expected to erase. Remarkably, we find that the most ubiquitous noise -- random fluctuations of on-site energies (dephasing) -- instead renders this asymmetry topologically robust. The density profile develops a skewness that grows in time while its center stays fixed, and in a finite chain the late-time relaxation modes pile up at one edge: a skin effect lacking the drift of conventional non-Hermitian skin effects. With multiple sites per unit cell, the dephasing strength alone can cause a topological phase transition, reversing the asymmetry. On a flux ladder with noisy rung hopping, the noise causes a drift of rung coherences, a quantum ratchet with no classical counterpart. Underlying these effects, the noise-averaged dynamics is an interacting (generically non-integrable) Lindbladian that remains analytically tractable. The modes governing late-time relaxation are bound states of the noise-induced interaction and form a band with a point gap, absent both without noise and under postselection, whose winding number fixes the direction of the asymmetry. These effects are within reach of several experimental platforms, including synthetic lattices, superconducting qubits, and optical lattices.
items.abstract_zh: 噪声通常破坏量子相干性，并冲淡依赖干涉的输运现象。手性量子行走就是一个例子：在穿有磁通的晶格上跃迁的粒子可因路径间干涉而呈现不对称扩散，而这种不对称预计会被噪声抹去。值得注意的是，我们发现最常见的噪声——格点能量的随机涨落（退相位）——反而使这种不对称具有拓扑鲁棒性。密度分布产生随时间增长的偏度，而其中心保持固定；在有限链中，晚期弛豫模式堆积在一侧边缘：这是一种缺少传统非厄米趋肤效应漂移的趋肤效应。当每个晶胞有多个格点时，仅退相位强度即可引起拓扑相变，使不对称反向。在具有噪声横档跃迁的磁通梯子上，噪声导致横档相干性的漂移，这是一种没有经典对应物的量子棘轮。这些效应背后的噪声平均动力学是一个相互作用（通常不可积）的Lindbladian，仍可解析处理。主导晚期弛豫的模式是噪声诱导相互作用的束缚态，并形成带有点隙的能带；无噪声时和后选择下均不存在该能带，其绕数确定不对称的方向。这些效应在若干实验平台上可实现，包括合成晶格、超导量子比特和光晶格。

items.title_en: Synthesis of Ovarian Cancer Multi-Omics Datasets: A Biology-Informed Evaluation Framework
items.title_zh: 卵巢癌多组学数据集的合成：一个生物学知识指导的评估框架
items.abstract_en: Paired multi-omic cancer cohorts are costly to assemble and difficult to share, motivating synthetic cohorts as a complementary resource. As generative model development accelerates, we shift the focus from proposing yet another architecture to defining evaluation criteria that determine whether synthetic data preserve biologically relevant structure. We introduce a biology-informed and patient-disjoint framework for evaluating the generation of paired RNA expression and copy-number variation (CNV) profiles, and apply it to the longitudinal DECIDER high-grade serous ovarian cancer cohort. The framework assesses modality-specific fidelity and coherence between RNA and CNV pairs using agreement between real training and held-out data as a reference, alongside complementary training-data proximity diagnostics. We adapt three multi-omic integration architectures based on variational autoencoders to generate paired profiles. The model leading several fidelity and coherence measures also shows the strongest training-data proximity. The protocol and case study offer the community a reference for comparing future multi-omic generators.
items.abstract_zh: 配对多组学癌症队列组装成本高昂且难以共享，促使合成队列作为补充资源。随着生成模型发展加速，我们将重点从提出又一种架构转向定义评估标准，以判定合成数据是否保留生物学相关结构。我们提出一个生物学知识指导且患者不重叠的框架，用于评估配对RNA表达和拷贝数变异（CNV）谱的生成，并将其应用于纵向DECIDER高级别浆液性卵巢癌队列。该框架以真实训练数据与留出数据之间的一致性为参考，评估模态特异性保真度以及RNA与CNV配对之间的连贯性，并辅以训练数据邻近性诊断。我们改编了三种基于变分自编码器的多组学整合架构来生成配对谱。在多项保真度和连贯性指标上领先的模型也表现出最强的训练数据邻近性。该协议和案例研究为社区比较未来多组学生成器提供了参考。

items.title_en: On the Opportunities and Challenges of Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-Model Transfer
items.title_zh: 从预填充到自回归的跨模型迁移的机遇与挑战
items.abstract_en: Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-model Transfer (PACT), a form of latent communication between language models, combines a larger model's prompt representations with a smaller model's efficient generation, offering a promising way to balance capability and inference cost. However, existing systems provide limited support for independently evaluating large-small model collaboration, and improved task performance alone does not establish whether the receiver benefits from the sender's information. We introduce PLatour, an open-source PACT framework that connects frozen models through lightweight, zero-initialized linear bridges trained directly with task rewards and supports hybrid-attention architectures. PLatour significantly outperforms open-source baselines on generation tasks and surpasses Mostik's reported results on shared mathematics and coding benchmarks using a substantially smaller sender. However, controlled experiments show that the gains on some tasks can be reproduced by uninformative sender signals, self-communication, or receiver-only training. We find that trainable bridges can act as parameter-efficient adaptation mechanisms without exploiting useful sender information. We therefore propose PACT-Check to quantify how much of a trained PACT system's gain genuinely comes from communication. Finally, we discuss the opportunities and challenges of PACT systems. Code is available at https://github.com/zhenyi4/platour.
items.abstract_zh: 预填充到自回归的跨模型迁移（PACT）是一种语言模型间潜在通信形式，它将较大模型的提示表示与较小模型的高效生成相结合，为平衡能力与推理成本提供了一种有前景的方式。然而，现有系统对独立评估大-小模型协作的支持有限，而仅凭任务性能提升并不能确定接收方是否从发送方信息中受益。我们提出PLatour，一个开源PACT框架，通过轻量、零初始化且直接以任务奖励训练的线性桥连接冻结模型，并支持混合注意力架构。PLatour在生成任务上显著优于开源基线，并在共享的数学和编码基准上使用小得多的发送方超越了Mostik报告的结果。然而，受控实验表明，某些任务上的增益可通过无信息发送方信号、自通信或仅训练接收方来复现。我们发现，可训练桥可作为参数高效的适应机制，而无需利用有用的发送方信息。因此，我们提出PACT-Check，以量化训练后的PACT系统增益中有多少真正来自通信。最后，我们讨论PACT系统的机遇与挑战。代码见 https://github.com/zhenyi4/platour。

items.title_en: ZipDrift: Generating Multimodal Short-Horizon MPC Costs with One-Step Drifting Models
items.title_zh: ZipDrift：使用一步漂移模型生成多模态短时域MPC代价
items.abstract_en: Short-horizon model predictive control (MPC) is fast but myopic. ZipMPC compensates by learning a context-dependent correction of the short-horizon cost that imitates a long-horizon expert. We observe that the optimal correction is often multimodal: when a slower opponent can be passed on either side, good corrections of opposite sign coexist, and the expert's choice between them hinges on tiny cost differences. Deterministic regression then averages modes or inherits inconsistent expert tie-breaking. We propose ZipDrift, which trains a one-step drifting generator over MPC cost corrections, tilted toward low closed-loop cost and learned only from cost evaluations of candidate corrections, without differentiating through the optimiser. A few generated candidates are ranked by a learned critic, and the model-based MPC then enforces dynamics and constraints. In a kinematic overtaking benchmark derived from ZipMPC, more than half of the contexts are bimodal and the manual short-horizon MPC crashes in 28% of them. With an eight-dimensional stagewise correction, evaluated on 1000 fresh contexts and five training seeds, ZipDrift with eight candidates crashes in 0.74% of episodes, compared with 3.4% for an idealised ZipMPC-style regressor and 2.1% for critic-ranked random candidates with the same budget. A mixture density network (MDN) with the same selection is equally good (0.76%). The benefit of drifting lies in sample quality: in a pre-specified test on further unseen contexts, a single drifting sample crashes in 8.7% of episodes against 13.2% for the MDN, and ZipDrift needs four candidates instead of eight to fall below 1%. With many candidates, all methods degrade as selection exploits errors of the critic.
items.abstract_zh: 短时域模型预测控制（MPC）速度快但短视。ZipMPC通过学习一个依赖上下文的短时域代价修正来补偿，该修正模仿长时域专家。我们观察到，最优修正通常是多模态的：当较慢的对手可从任一侧超越时，符号相反的良好修正共存，而专家在二者之间的选择取决于微小的代价差异。确定性回归因此会平均各模态，或继承专家不一致的平局处理。我们提出ZipDrift，它在MPC代价修正上训练一步漂移生成器，偏向低闭环代价，并且仅从候选修正的代价评估中学习，而不通过优化器求导。少量生成的候选由学习到的评论器排序，随后基于模型的MPC施加动力学和约束。在由ZipMPC衍生的运动学超车基准中，超过一半的上下文是双峰的，手工短时域MPC在其中28%的情况下发生碰撞。使用八维逐阶段修正，在1000个新上下文和五个训练种子上评估，带八个候选的ZipDrift在0.74%的回合中发生碰撞，而理想化的ZipMPC式回归器为3.4%，相同预算下经评论器排序的随机候选为2.1%。采用相同选择方式的混合密度网络（MDN）同样好（0.76%）。漂移的优势在于样本质量：在针对更多未见上下文的预先指定测试中，单个漂移样本在8.7%的回合中发生碰撞，而MDN为13.2%；ZipDrift只需四个而非八个候选即可降至1%以下。当候选很多时，所有方法都会退化，因为选择会利用评论器的误差。

items.title_en: Agent-Driven Generative Priors for Pathology Image Synthesis and Segmentation
items.title_zh: 智能体驱动的生成先验用于病理图像合成与分割
items.abstract_en: Deep learning methods for pathology are constrained by the limited availability and high cost of large-scale pixel-level annotations. Synthetic data can alleviate this limitation, but existing pipelines often lack reliable quality control and remain weakly connected to downstream analysis. To address these issues, we propose a three-stage framework that integrates automated data screening, generative representation learning, and efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. First, we develop a pathology agent system to assess image quality and filter samples, resulting in TCGA-200K, a dataset containing 217,030 pathology patches selected from the public TCGA repository. Second, we train a generative model on the screened data. In addition to image synthesis, its backbone learns structural and semantic representations that can be transferred to downstream tasks. Third, we adapt the pretrained generative backbone to semantic segmentation using a lightweight task-specific head. We further introduce PathSeg-380K, a semantic segmentation dataset with expert annotations for approximately 380,000 cells across 12 cell types. Experiments on multiple pathology datasets show that the proposed framework achieves state-of-the-art segmentation performance. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/script-Yang/Agent-GenPath.
items.abstract_zh: 病理学深度学习方法受限于大规模像素级标注的可得性有限且成本高昂。合成数据可以缓解这一限制，但现有流程往往缺乏可靠的质量控制，且与下游分析联系较弱。为解决这些问题，我们提出一个三阶段框架，集成自动数据筛选、生成式表征学习以及对下游任务的高效适配。首先，我们开发病理智能体系统来评估图像质量并过滤样本，形成 TCGA-200K，这是一个包含从公开 TCGA 仓库中选出的 217,030 个病理图像块的数据集。其次，我们在筛选后的数据上训练生成模型。除图像合成外，其骨干网络还学习可迁移至下游任务的结构与语义表征。第三，我们使用轻量级任务专用头将预训练生成骨干适配到语义分割。我们进一步引入 PathSeg-380K，这是一个语义分割数据集，包含由专家标注的约 380,000 个细胞、覆盖 12 种细胞类型。在多个病理数据集上的实验表明，所提出框架达到最先进的分割性能。我们的代码公开于 https://github.com/script-Yang/Agent-GenPath。

items.title_en: Regionalisation of muscle nucleus heterogeneity in foetal skeletal muscle
items.title_zh: 胎儿骨骼肌中肌核异质性的区域化
items.abstract_en: Skeletal muscle is organized into functional domains with attachments at both extremities to tendons via the myotendinous junction (MTJ) and innervation in the middle via the neuromuscular junction (NMJ). In adult muscle, the molecular heterogeneity of muscle domains is described at the level of myonuclei with specialized MTJ and NMJ myonuclei at the tips and middle of muscle fibre. However, the regionalisation of molecular heterogeneity remains poorly understood during development. Combining single-cell and single-nucleus RNA sequencing approaches with in situ hybridization experiments to limb muscles of chicken embryos, we uncover transcriptionally distinct muscle nuclei according to tip and central domains, in both myofibres and mononucleated myogenic cells. At early foetal stage, all myonuclei display either a tip or a central domain identity. Immature mononucleated myogenic cells are enriched in the tip domain. Tip myonuclei of foetal muscles show a robust transcriptional signal transduction signature, which highlights molecular crosstalks with adjacent tendon fibroblasts but also with adjacent immature myogenic cells. We propose that the tip muscle domain is a signalling centre interacting with tendon fibroblasts to regulate muscle/tendon attachment and with adjacent mononucleated muscle cells to regulate myogenesis in limb foetal muscles.
items.abstract_zh: 骨骼肌被组织为功能结构域：两端通过肌腱连接处（MTJ）附着于肌腱，中部通过神经肌肉接头（NMJ）接受神经支配。在成年肌肉中，肌肉结构域的分子异质性已在肌核层面得到描述，即肌纤维末端和中部分别具有特化的 MTJ 和 NMJ 肌核。然而，发育过程中分子异质性的区域化仍知之甚少。结合单细胞和单核 RNA 测序方法，并对鸡胚肢体肌肉进行原位杂交实验，我们揭示了在肌纤维和单核生肌细胞中，根据末端和中央结构域而转录上不同的肌核。在早期胎儿阶段，所有肌核均显示末端或中央结构域身份。未成熟单核生肌细胞富集于末端结构域。胎儿肌肉的末端肌核表现出强烈的转录信号转导特征，这突出了其与相邻腱成纤维细胞、也与相邻未成熟生肌细胞的分子互作。我们提出，末端肌肉结构域是一个信号中心，与腱成纤维细胞相互作用以调控肌肉/肌腱附着，并与相邻单核肌肉细胞相互作用以调控肢体胎儿肌肉中的肌发生。

items.title_en: Room-Temperature Quantum Emission from Boron Nitride Nanotubes
items.title_zh: 氮化硼纳米管的室温量子发射
items.abstract_en: Quantum information systems such as quantum key distribution and quantum communications require bright, high-purity, stable sources of single photons to act as carriers of quantum information. As such, methods for obtaining single photon emitters (SPEs) in solid-state devices capable of articulating with quantum photonic circuits are a necessary obstacle that must be overcome. Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) flakes have been extensively studied as a host material for SPEs, though working in two dimensions is accompanied by engineering complexity. However, dimensionality can be reduced through the implementation of boron nitride nanotubes (BNNTs). Here we investigate the potential of BNNTs as room-temperature SPEs using confocal photoluminescence microscopy and Hanbury Brown-Twiss interferometry. Quantum emitters were found in BNNTs spanning the entirety of the visible spectrum, including spectral regions where SPEs within hBN have not been reported. Furthermore, each tube was found to possess multiple SPEs at varying emission wavelengths along the length, exhibiting lifetimes as fast as 0.5 ns, which is about two-fold faster than the fastest hBN SPEs. Additionally, we demonstrate that surface passivation/coating mitigates blinking events, therefore increasing the emitter stability. Thus, BNNTs can function as a single structure supporting a variety of multiwavelength SPE sources, while maintaining a compact radius of ~25 nm, making them ideally suited for deterministic placement and integration within nanophotonic devices such as waveguides and interferometric filters.
items.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发和量子通信等量子信息系统需要明亮、高纯度、稳定的单光子源作为量子信息载体。因此，在能够与量子光子电路衔接的固态器件中获得单光子发射器（SPE）的方法，是必须克服的必要障碍。六方氮化硼（hBN）薄片已被广泛研究作为 SPE 的宿主材料，但在二维中工作伴随工程复杂性。然而，通过采用氮化硼纳米管（BNNT）可以降低维度。在此，我们使用共聚焦光致发光显微术和 Hanbury Brown–Twiss 干涉术研究 BNNT 作为室温 SPE 的潜力。在 BNNT 中发现了覆盖整个可见光谱的量子发射器，包括 hBN 内尚未报道 SPE 的光谱区域。此外，发现每根管沿长度方向在可变发射波长处具有多个 SPE，其寿命可快至 0.5 ns，约为最快的 hBN SPE 的两倍快。此外，我们证明表面钝化/涂层可减轻闪烁事件，从而提高发射器稳定性。因此，BNNT 可作为支持多种多波长 SPE 源的单一线结构，同时保持约 25 nm 的紧凑半径，使其非常适合确定性放置并集成到波导和干涉滤光片等纳米光子器件中。

items.title_en: When Less is More: Emerging Network-Wide Use Cases for Hollow-Core Fibers in Optical Networks [Invited]
items.title_zh: 少即是多：空芯光纤在光网络中的新兴全网用例 [特邀]
items.abstract_en: Hollow-Core Fiber (HCF) is emerging as a disruptive technology for next-generation optical networks, offering 30\% lower propagation latency than standard Single-Mode Fiber (SMF), record-low attenuation (0.05-0.1 dB/km), and nonlinearities reduced by three to four orders of magnitude. While the physical-layer benefits of HCF have been extensively demonstrated, recent industrial commitments by hyperscalers (e.g., Microsoft, Amazon) and the rapid maturation of nested antiresonant nodeless fibers (NANF) call for a systematic assessment of the impact of HCF at the network level. Building on a series of prior contributions, we overview four emerging network-wide use cases for the selective deployment of HCF in hybrid SMF/HCF networks: (i) latency-constrained Edge Data Center (edgeDC) consolidation; (ii) energy-efficient high-power amplification; (iii) capacity scaling via single-fiber bidirectional (BiDi) transmission; and (iv) coexistence of classical and quantum (QKD) channels. Consolidated results across realistic metro, national, and continental topologies convey a unifying message: in each use case, a selective HCF upgrade captures a significant share of the achievable benefit compared to a network overhaul. The required HCF budget is use-case-specific, i.e., 6-24\% of the total network fiber length for edgeDC consolidation (up to 50\% fewer edgeDCs), 40\% of the network links for QKD/classical coexistence (up to 38\% fewer quantum modules), and 40-60\% of the network links for energy-efficient capacity scaling via BiDi-HCF (up to 28\% lower network power per Tbps and 70\% more served traffic, at half the HCF strand count of a unidirectional HCF upgrade), whereas for energy-efficient high-power amplification the gain keeps growing with the HCF budget (up to 60\% lower network power per Tbps at the national scale) and what saturates is the benefit of increasing the EDFA output power.
items.abstract_zh: 空芯光纤（HCF）正成为下一代光网络的颠覆性技术，其传播时延比标准单模光纤（SMF）低 30%，具有创纪录的低衰减（0.05–0.1 dB/km），且非线性降低三到四个数量级。虽然 HCF 的物理层优势已被广泛证明，但近期超大规模云厂商（如 Microsoft、Amazon）的产业投入以及嵌套反谐振无节点光纤（NANF）的快速成熟，要求对 HCF 在网络层面的影响进行系统评估。基于一系列先前工作，我们概述了在混合 SMF/HCF 网络中选择性部署 HCF 的四个新兴全网用例：(i) 受时延约束的边缘数据中心（edgeDC）整合；(ii) 节能的高功率放大；(iii) 通过单纤双向（BiDi）传输实现容量扩展；(iv) 经典与量子（QKD）信道的共存。在现实城域、国家和洲际拓扑上的汇总结果传达了一致信息：在每个用例中，与网络全面改造相比，选择性 HCF 升级可获得可实现收益的显著部分。所需 HCF 预算因用例而异，即 edgeDC 整合为总网络光纤长度的 6–24%（edgeDC 最多减少 50%），QKD/经典共存为网络链路的 40%（量子模块最多减少 38%），通过 BiDi-HCF 实现节能容量扩展为网络链路的 40–60%（每 Tbps 网络功耗最多降低 28%，服务流量增加 70%，且 HCF 纤芯数为单向 HCF 升级的一半）；而对于节能的高功率放大，增益随 HCF 预算持续增长（在全国尺度上每 Tbps 网络功耗最多降低 60%），而饱和的是提高 EDFA 输出功率所带来的收益。

items.title_en: Cultural Adaptation within Repeated Social Interactions
items.title_zh: 重复社会互动中的文化适应
items.abstract_en: Much of human culture is tacit and is typically learned through situated social interaction. As LLMs are deployed as interactive agents across diverse communities, assessing their cultural competence demands moving beyond existing question-answering approaches, shifting from what they know to how they adapt. In this work, we broaden the scope of cultural adaptation in NLP by investigating whether LLMs can adapt through repeated interactions via a sandbox environment. By reframing cultural adaptation as a continuous process of norm assimilation through social interaction, our work demonstrates that memory mechanisms foster longitudinal learning across repeated interactions, facilitate transfer to different social settings, and enable multilingual norm assimilation across five languages. Together, our findings lay the groundwork for continuous, interaction-driven cultural adaptation in LLMs.
items.abstract_zh: 人类文化很大一部分是隐性的，通常通过情境化社会互动习得。随着 LLM 作为交互式智能体部署于多样社区，评估其文化能力需要超越现有问答方法，从它们知道什么转向它们如何适应。在本工作中，我们通过沙盒环境研究 LLM 能否在重复互动中适应，从而拓宽 NLP 中文化适应的范围。通过将文化适应重新表述为通过社会互动进行规范同化的连续过程，我们的工作表明，记忆机制促进跨重复互动的纵向学习，促进向不同社会情境的迁移，并在五种语言间实现多语言规范同化。总之，我们的发现为 LLM 中连续的、互动驱动的文化适应奠定基础。

items.title_en: OdorSpaces: Visual-Olfactory Embodied Navigation in 3D Environments
items.title_zh: OdorSpaces：三维环境中的视觉-嗅觉具身导航
items.abstract_en: Olfaction provides critical information about airborne chemical cues, yet it remains largely underexplored in embodied AI, with limited prior machine olfaction work focusing primarily on semantic odor perception. We introduce OdorSpaces, a physics-based simulation platform and benchmark for visual-olfactory embodied navigation. OdorSpaces augments Habitat-Sim with 3D odor transport and dispersion simulated by Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS), enabling agents to navigate photorealistic indoor environments using both visual and olfactory observations. The benchmark includes two representative source-seeking scenarios: invisible gas-leak localization and early-stage fire localization. We develop an initial multimodal reinforcement learning policy that integrates visual observations and olfactory measurements over time. Experiments show that the policy outperforms a diverse set of baselines, establishing a strong reference for future research on visual-olfactory embodied navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 嗅觉提供关于空气传播化学线索的关键信息，但在具身 AI 中仍很大程度上未被充分探索，先前机器嗅觉工作有限且主要集中于语义气味感知。我们引入 OdorSpaces，一个基于物理的仿真平台和视觉-嗅觉具身导航基准。OdorSpaces 通过 Fire Dynamics Simulator（FDS）模拟的三维气味传输与扩散扩展 Habitat-Sim，使智能体能够利用视觉和嗅觉观测在照片级真实感室内环境中导航。该基准包括两个代表性源搜索场景：不可见气体泄漏定位和早期火灾定位。我们开发了一种初始多模态强化学习策略，随时间整合视觉观测和嗅觉测量。实验表明，该策略优于多种基线，为未来视觉-嗅觉具身导航研究建立了有力参考。

items.title_en: Adaptive Low-Light Enhancement for Road Anomaly Detection: A Multi-Architecture Benchmark and Edge Deployment Study
items.title_zh: 面向道路异常检测的自适应低光照增强：多架构基准测试与边缘部署研究
items.abstract_en: Road anomaly detection systems on autonomous vehicles must function reliably under degraded visual conditions including darkness, rain, and Harmattan dust haze. This paper benchmarks four object detection architectures, YOLOv8n, YOLOv12n, RT-DETR, and Faster R-CNN, under physically grounded lighting and weather degradation, and shows that uniform application of the SCI low-light enhancement network is actively harmful at dusk-level lighting (-16.1% to -30.7% mAP@50). We propose a lightweight, training-free luminance-adaptive router that selects between no enhancement, moderate SCI, and denoising plus strong SCI based on per-frame Rec. 601 luminance, recovering most of the dusk penalty while preserving low-light gains, and we validate the full pipeline on NVIDIA Jetson Nano edge hardware.
items.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶车辆上的道路异常检测系统必须在包括黑暗、降雨和哈马丹尘霾在内的退化视觉条件下可靠运行。本文在基于物理建模的光照与天气退化条件下，对YOLOv8n、YOLOv12n、RT-DETR和Faster R-CNN四种目标检测架构进行基准测试，并表明统一应用SCI低光照增强网络在黄昏级光照下反而有害（mAP@50下降16.1%至30.7%）。我们提出一种轻量、无需训练的亮度自适应路由器，根据每帧的Rec. 601亮度在无增强、中等SCI增强以及去噪加强SCI增强之间进行选择，在保留低光照增益的同时恢复大部分黄昏性能损失，并在NVIDIA Jetson Nano边缘硬件上验证了完整流程。

items.title_en: Intravital microscopy and statistical image analysis of early engraftment of haematopoietic stem cells reveal dynamic and evolving cellular behaviours linked to progressive differentiation.
items.title_zh: 造血干细胞早期植入的活体显微成像与统计图像分析揭示与渐进性分化相关的动态且演变的细胞行为
items.abstract_en: Haematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) have long been used in the clinic for bone marrow transplantation applications, critical for the survival of an increasingly wide range of patients with haematological, oncological and immunological pathologies. Despite this, little is known about the mechanisms through which relatively few stem cells are able to regenerate the entire haematopoietic tissue of transplant recipients. To gain insights on this biological process, we used intravital microscopy of calvarium bone marrow, collecting tissue-wide images and a total of 850 hours of tracks of engrafting haematopoietic stem and progenitor cells from 24 hours to 8 days following injection in lethally irradiated recipients. Analysis of the data revealed that regenerating HSCs and their immediate progeny are highly dynamic, migrating through the parenchyma at both the microscopic and near-macroscopic scales, i.e. within and in-and-out of fields of view. HSC-derived cell clusters, expanded locally between day 2 and day 4 post-transplant, leading to patches of densely populated bone marrow by day 8. Single cell level analysis highlighted increasingly heterogenous cellular behaviours over time. Track clustering based on migration and niche interaction parameters combined with post-tracking whole mount immunostaining revealed that persistence in the vicinity of nestin-GFP perivascular cells and relatively slow movement correlated with stemness, while more heterogeneous niche interactions coupled with slowest or faster migration correlated with differentiation, validated through flow cytometry analysis and functional studies. The findings presented here shed light on the fundamental principles driving haematopoietic regeneration in transplantation settings.
items.abstract_zh: 造血干细胞（HSC）长期用于临床骨髓移植，对越来越多血液学、肿瘤学和免疫学疾病患者的生存至关重要。尽管如此，相对少量的干细胞如何能够再生移植受者整个造血组织的机制仍知之甚少。为深入理解这一生物学过程，我们使用颅骨骨髓活体显微成像，采集全组织图像，并记录了致死照射受者注射后24小时至8天期间共850小时的植入造血干细胞和祖细胞轨迹。数据分析显示，再生的HSC及其直接子代高度动态，在微观和近宏观尺度上通过实质迁移，即在视野内以及进出视野。HSC来源的细胞簇在移植后第2天至第4天局部扩增，到第8天形成细胞密集分布的骨髓斑块。单细胞水平分析突出显示，细胞行为随时间变得越来越异质。基于迁移和微环境相互作用参数的轨迹聚类，结合轨迹追踪后的全组织免疫染色显示，在nestin-GFP血管周围细胞附近持续存在以及相对缓慢的移动与干性相关，而更异质的微环境相互作用伴随最慢或较快的迁移与分化相关，并通过流式细胞术分析和功能研究得到验证。这些发现揭示了移植环境中驱动造血再生的基本原理。

items.title_en: Quantum enhanced beam displacement estimation: sensitivity limits, optimal probes, and measurement schemes
items.title_zh: 量子增强的光束位移估计：灵敏度极限、最优探针与测量方案
items.abstract_en: We investigate the ultimate sensitivity limits for measuring small transverse beam displacements and identify optimal strategies that attain them, using the framework of mode parameter estimation. We contrast two families of states with different resource constraints, using Hermite-Gauss and Laguerre-Gauss mode pairs. First, for fixed total photon number states, the optimal state is identified and we show that it asymptotically approaches a rotated NOON state. The sensitivity bound is compared to that of an asymptotically optimal pure Gaussian state with fixed average photon number. Finally, we propose concrete measurement schemes using the method of moments and show that the twin-Fock state may provide a viable alternative to the rotated NOON state for this task. Our work provides a broader benchmark for developing practical strategies for spatial sensing at the quantum limit.
items.abstract_zh: 我们在模式参数估计框架下研究测量微小横向光束位移的最终灵敏度极限，并确定达到这些极限的最优策略。我们使用厄米-高斯和拉盖尔-高斯模式对，对比两类具有不同资源约束的态。首先，对于固定总光子数态，我们确定了最优态，并证明其渐近逼近旋转NOON态。我们将该灵敏度界与固定平均光子数的渐近最优纯高斯态的灵敏度界进行比较。最后，我们提出基于矩方法的具体测量方案，并表明双Fock态可能成为该任务中旋转NOON态的可行替代方案。我们的工作为在量子极限下开发空间传感的实用策略提供了更广泛的基准。

items.title_en: Joint Modeling of Conditional Mean and Variability in Multilevel Functional Data: Application to Postprandial Glucose Trajectories in the AEGIS Study
items.title_zh: 多水平函数型数据中条件均值与变异性的联合建模：应用于AEGIS研究中的餐后血糖轨迹
items.abstract_en: Functional data analysis provides a framework for studying time-varying associations between covariates and high-frequency biological signals. In digital health, participants often contribute repeated functional trajectories, yet existing multilevel regression methods largely focus on the conditional mean, overlooking variability and its role in biological heterogeneity. We propose a heteroskedastic functional mixed-effects regression framework that jointly models the conditional mean and variance of repeated trajectories, with participant-specific random effects in both components. We also develop a participant-level bootstrap to quantify uncertainty in estimated functional parameters. We apply the method to postprandial glucose trajectories from the AEGIS study. Premeal glucose, carbohydrate intake, and meal type show distinct time-dependent associations with glucose variability, whereas HbA1c is more strongly associated with the conditional mean than with variability. Substantial between-participant differences in residual variability remain even after accounting for observed covariates. These findings show that modeling conditional variability alongside the mean provides insights into glucose regulation and individual heterogeneity that mean-focused analyses may miss. More broadly, the proposed framework enables joint characterization of average responses, variability, and participant-specific heterogeneity in repeated biological signals.
items.abstract_zh: 函数型数据分析为研究协变量与高频生物信号之间的时变关联提供了框架。在数字健康中，参与者通常会贡献重复的函数型轨迹，但现有的多水平回归方法主要关注条件均值，忽视了变异性及其在生物学异质性中的作用。我们提出一种异方差函数型混合效应回归框架，联合建模重复轨迹的条件均值和方差，并在两个成分中均包含参与者特异随机效应。我们还开发了一种参与者水平bootstrap，用于量化估计的函数型参数的不确定性。我们将该方法应用于AEGIS研究中的餐后血糖轨迹。餐前血糖、碳水化合物摄入量和餐食类型与血糖变异性呈现不同的时间依赖关联，而HbA1c与条件均值的关联强于与变异性的关联。即使考虑观察到的协变量，残差变异性仍存在显著的参与者间差异。这些发现表明，在建模均值的同时建模条件变异性，可以揭示以均值为中心的分析可能遗漏的血糖调节和个体异质性信息。更广泛地说，所提出的框架能够联合刻画重复生物信号中的平均响应、变异性和参与者特异异质性。

items.title_en: Polarity Classification with Multitask Learning Syntax Augmentation
items.title_zh: 结合多任务学习句法增强的极性分类
items.abstract_en: Sentiment Analysis (SA) is a fundamental NLP task concerned with the identification and categorization of subjective information in text. While lexicon-based methods offer transparency, they often struggle with linguistic phenomena such as negation and intensification. Syntactic parsing has been integrated into SA pipelines to address this, but conventional parsers introduce significant computational overhead. Recent work shows that reformulating dependency parsing as a Sequence Labeling (SEL) task can improve efficiency. We propose and compare two strategies for integrating syntactic knowledge into a neural sentiment analysis model under unified Multi-Task Learning (MTL). The first, Standard-MTL, jointly learns dependency parsing (via sequence labeling) and sentiment polarity classification using a shared encoder with two task-specific heads. The second, Contrastive-MTL, provides implicit syntactic guidance through a contrastive auxiliary objective and a syntax-biased attention pooling mechanism, without requiring explicit label prediction. Both rely on syntactic annotations during training and eliminate need for hand-crafted compositional rules or external parsing at inference. We evaluate eleven datasets spanning seven languages---the MARC corpus (English, Spanish, French, German) and seven datasets from SemEval-2022 Task 10 (English, Spanish, Norwegian, Basque, Catalan)---using four established SEL encodings. With the relative encoding, Contrastive-MTL outperforms a syntax-naive baseline on 10 of 11 datasets and surpasses the external rule-based pipeline (SELSP) that parses at inference on all six datasets where the latter applies, while being 1.5--9$\times$ faster at evaluation. Standard-MTL is more dataset- and encoding-dependent. These results show implicit syntactic supervision during training can match or exceed explicit parsing at inference without computational overhead.
items.abstract_zh: 情感分析（SA）是一项基础NLP任务，关注文本中主观信息的识别与分类。基于词典的方法具有透明性，但往往难以处理否定和强化等语言现象。句法分析已被整合到SA流程中以应对这些问题，但传统解析器会带来显著的计算开销。近期工作表明，将依存句法分析重构为序列标注（SEL）任务可以提高效率。我们提出并比较了在统一多任务学习（MTL）下将句法知识整合到神经情感分析模型中的两种策略。第一种是Standard-MTL，使用共享编码器和两个任务专用头联合学习依存句法分析（通过序列标注）和情感极性分类。第二种是Contrastive-MTL，通过对比辅助目标和句法偏置的注意力池化机制提供隐式句法指导，而无需显式标签预测。两者在训练时均依赖句法标注，并消除了推理时对手工组合规则或外部句法分析的需求。我们使用四种既有的SEL编码，在涵盖七种语言的十一个数据集上评估——MARC语料库（英语、西班牙语、法语、德语）以及SemEval-2022 Task 10的七个数据集（英语、西班牙语、挪威语、巴斯克语、加泰罗尼亚语）。采用相对编码时，Contrastive-MTL在11个数据集中的10个上优于无句法基线，并在后者适用的全部6个数据集上超过在推理时进行句法分析的外部规则流水线（SELSP），同时在评估时快1.5至9倍。Standard-MTL则更依赖数据集和编码。这些结果表明，训练期间的隐式句法监督可以在推理时匹配或超过显式句法分析，且无计算开销。

items.title_en: A Multimodal Haptic Interface for Simultaneous Softness and Thermal Modulation
items.title_zh: 用于同时调节柔软度与温度的多模态触觉接口
items.abstract_en: Haptic interactions, such as touching an object in virtual reality, involve detecting a plethora of sensations through the skin. Whilst tactile displays exist to simulate and manipulate all of these cues individually, little progress has been made constructing devices that can control multiple cues simultaneously. This paper presents a tactile display technology that offers both softness and temperature change. A prototype display, based on particle jamming and the thermal transfer of heated and cooled water, is evaluated in terms of its ability to change both stiffness and temperature. Mechanical evaluations demonstrate controllable stiffness increase of 300%, whilst thermal characterisation showed strong surface uniformity and a range of achievable temperatures from 10°C up to 50°C, with closed-loop control maintaining a 0.2°C error from a setpoint. This work advances the design of multimodal tactile displays with applications to perceptual research, medical simulation, and affective haptics.
items.abstract_zh: 触觉交互，例如在虚拟现实中触摸物体，涉及通过皮肤检测大量感觉。尽管现有触觉显示器可以单独模拟和操控所有这些线索，但在构建能够同时控制多种线索的设备方面进展甚微。本文提出一种同时提供柔软度和温度变化的触觉显示技术。基于颗粒阻塞以及加热和冷却水热传递的原型显示器，从其改变刚度和温度的能力方面进行了评估。机械评估表明刚度可控制地增加300%，热表征显示出良好的表面均匀性，可实现温度范围为10°C至50°C，闭环控制将相对设定点的误差保持在0.2°C。这项工作推动了多模态触觉显示器的设计，应用于知觉研究、医学模拟和情感触觉。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: MCUFlowNet: Hardware-Aware Neural Architecture Search for Optical Flow on Microcontrollers
items.title_zh: MCUFlowNet：面向微控制器的硬件感知光流神经网络架构搜索
items.abstract_en: Dense optical flow allows small drones to avoid obstacles. However, few dense optical flow networks are designed for microcontrollers (MCUs) with neural accelerators, whose on-chip SRAM limits the input resolution. We present PACE-NAS, a macro-to-micro neural architecture search framework that decouples memory from latency: a macro design fixes the backbone and its peak SRAM, and a micro design searches operators and depths to trade accuracy against compiler-estimated latency. We apply it to EdgeFlowNet on a Grove Vision AI V2 board (Ethos-U55), where profiling locates the peak SRAM at the full-resolution output head. Replacing transposed convolutions with bilinear upsampling and convolutions lowers the peak SRAM by 18%, and two lightweight context modules lower the endpoint error (EPE) without raising the peak. All searched subnets share this peak, so the search needs no memory constraint. We name the Pareto-optimal models MCUFlowNet; the fastest variant, MCUFlowNet-S, runs 1.76x faster than a retrained EdgeFlowNet at a 1.6% higher EPE and, in simulated forest flights at 2 m/s, reaches the goal without collision in 51.5% of trials, against 41.8%. PACE-NAS also applies to semantic segmentation, where a searched PIDNet-S variant runs 1.17x faster at similar accuracy. Code is available at https://gitlab.kuleuven.be/emedia-research-lab/esat-stadius/mcuflownet/mcuflownet.
items.abstract_zh: 稠密光流使小型无人机能够避障。然而，很少有稠密光流网络针对带有神经加速器的微控制器（MCU）设计，其片上 SRAM 限制了输入分辨率。我们提出 PACE-NAS，一种从宏观到微观的神经网络架构搜索框架，将内存与延迟解耦：宏观设计固定骨干网络及其峰值 SRAM，微观设计搜索算子和深度，以在精度与编译器估计的延迟之间权衡。我们将其应用于 Grove Vision AI V2 板（Ethos-U55）上的 EdgeFlowNet，性能剖析将峰值 SRAM 定位在全分辨率输出头。用双线性上采样和卷积替换转置卷积使峰值 SRAM 降低 18%，两个轻量上下文模块降低了端点误差（EPE），且未提高峰值。所有搜索得到的子网共享该峰值，因此搜索无需内存约束。我们将帕累托最优模型命名为 MCUFlowNet；最快的变体 MCUFlowNet-S 比重新训练的 EdgeFlowNet 快 1.76 倍，EPE 高 1.6%，在 2 m/s 的模拟森林飞行中，51.5% 的试验无碰撞到达目标，而对比方法为 41.8%。PACE-NAS 也适用于语义分割，其中搜索得到的 PIDNet-S 变体在相似精度下运行速度快 1.17 倍。代码见 https://gitlab.kuleuven.be/emedia-research-lab/esat-stadius/mcuflownet/mcuflownet。

items.title_en: Sexual interactions and local selection shape reproductive gene diversity and divergence
items.title_zh: 性相互作用与局部选择塑造生殖基因多样性与分化
items.abstract_en: Genes involved in genotype x genotype coevolution display unique patterns of nucleotide diversity and population divergence. In Drosophila melanogaster, Sex Peptide is a key sperm competition gene that is an outlier for both pi within populations and Fst between populations. This pattern is not predicted by current theoretical expectations of selective sweeps highlighting the need to develop predictions to identify genes experiencing balancing selection. We compared pi and FST in D. melanogaster populations to identify other genes following a co-evolutionary model that generates divergence and diversity. Multiple male and female genes that interact with Sex Peptide exhibited elevated FST x pi values. Genome-wide analyses also revealed an enrichment of genes critical for neuronal development, pointing to courtship evolution. Specifically, fruitless, its interacting genes, and a female behavior gene were identified as outliers. These parallel findings indicate that both sperm competition and mating behaviors are subject to co-evolutionary selection.
items.abstract_zh: 参与基因型×基因型协同进化的基因表现出独特的核苷酸多样性和种群分化模式。在黑腹果蝇中，性肽（Sex Peptide）是一个关键的精细竞争基因，在种群内 pi 和种群间 Fst 上均为离群值。当前的选择性清除理论预期无法预测这种模式，这凸显了需要发展预测以识别经历平衡选择的基因。我们比较了黑腹果蝇种群的 pi 和 FST，以识别遵循产生分化和多样性的协同进化模型的其他基因。多个与性肽相互作用的雄性和雌性基因表现出升高的 FST×pi 值。全基因组分析还揭示了对神经元发育至关重要的基因富集，指向求偶行为的进化。具体而言，fruitless、其相互作用基因以及一个雌性行为基因被识别为离群值。这些平行发现表明，精细竞争和交配行为都受到协同进化选择的影响。

items.title_en: Beyond Quantum Messages: Toward Quantum-Native Network Functioning
items.title_zh: 超越量子消息：迈向量子原生网络功能
items.abstract_en: The Quantum Internet is commonly envisioned as a network that transports quantum states and distributes entanglement as the key resource underpinning distributed quantum applications. This view is necessary but incomplete if quantum phenomena are confined to what the network carries or manages, while network functionalities remain grounded predominantly in classical abstractions. This Perspective advances a broader thesis: quantum phenomena can also participate directly in the realization of network functionalities. We first establish the architectural baseline by introducing entanglement as a stateful network resource whose operational condition is non-locally distributed across remote nodes, evolves through manipulation or consumption, and degrades over time through decoherence. Its evolving state must therefore remain visible to the functionalities acting on it. We then move beyond resource visibility and use two mechanisms as proof points of a broader quantum-native functional design space: entanglement generation during propagation through coherent spatial-path superposition, and operational connectivity induced by shared entanglement that can depart from the physical graph. These examples show that paths, neighbors, or participating nodes may become operationally relevant in ways determined by quantum coherence and shared entanglement, rather than by physical connectivity alone. We identify Quantum Addressing as a transversal abstraction capable of representing such relations while complementing, rather than replacing, classical addressing and signaling. The resulting perspective broadens the Quantum Internet from transporting quantum information and distributing entanglement to exploiting quantum phenomena in network functioning, opening a coupled frontier spanning routing, forwarding, control, and functionality placement.
items.abstract_zh: 量子互联网通常被设想为一种传输量子态并分发纠缠的网络，纠缠是支撑分布式量子应用的关键资源。如果量子现象仅限于网络所承载或管理的内容，而网络功能仍主要基于经典抽象，那么这种观点虽必要但不完整。本文提出更广泛的论点：量子现象也可以直接参与网络功能的实现。我们首先建立架构基线，将纠缠引入为一种有状态网络资源，其运行条件非局部地分布在远程节点上，通过操纵或消耗而演化，并随时间因退相干而退化。因此，其演化状态必须对作用于其上的功能保持可见。然后，我们超越资源可见性，用两种机制作为更广泛的量子原生功能设计空间的证明点：通过相干空间路径叠加在传播过程中生成纠缠，以及由共享纠缠诱导的、可以偏离物理图的操作连通性。这些例子表明，路径、邻居或参与节点可能在操作上变得相关，其方式由量子相干性和共享纠缠决定，而不仅仅是物理连通性。我们将量子寻址识别为一种横向抽象，能够表示此类关系，同时补充而非取代经典寻址和信令。由此产生的视角将量子互联网从传输量子信息和分发纠缠扩展到在网络功能中利用量子现象，开辟了涵盖路由、转发、控制和功能放置的耦合前沿。

items.title_en: Static Recovery Is Not Dynamic Stability: Dynamics-Aware Benchmarking of Protein Motif Scaffolding
items.title_zh: 静态恢复并非动态稳定性：蛋白质基序支架设计的动力学感知基准测试
items.abstract_en: Protein motif scaffolding benchmarks assess whether generative models can build scaffolds around functionally important residues. Their conclusions depend on which motifs are tested and which criteria define success. Existing benchmarks typically use small hand-curated motif sets and static refolding criteria, but protein function often depends on conformational ensembles and transitions. Here, we address both benchmark scope and success criteria. We introduce BILBY-PRO, a systematically derived benchmark of structurally conserved functional motifs from PROSITE-linked experimental structures, comprising 220 cases from 174 PROSITE motif-pattern entries. Evaluating six recent scaffold-generation models reveals distinct patterns in target coverage and unique-solution yield: RFDiffusion and Proteina solve more targets, whereas ESM3 produces more unique successful scaffolds on the targets it solves. We further introduce BILBY-MD, a reference-based all-atom molecular dynamics evaluation framework. Applied to statically solved designs from the original MotifBench benchmark, it compares motif drift, scaffold drift, motif-contact preservation, and motif-dihedral free-energy landscapes against reference simulations. Of 55 statically solved model-problem pairs, 31 satisfy our MD-supported criterion and only 8 pass all checks. Compact, self-contained motifs are often MD-supported, whereas interface-like or context-dependent motifs fail more frequently. Static refolding success therefore provides useful evidence of local motif recovery but does not establish dynamical fidelity of the full scaffold. BILBY highlights three complementary axes of motif-scaffolding evaluation: target coverage, unique-solution yield, and MD-supported dynamical fidelity.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质基序支架基准评估生成模型是否能在功能重要残基周围构建支架。其结论取决于测试哪些基序以及哪些标准定义成功。现有基准通常使用小型手工整理的基序集和静态重折叠标准，但蛋白质功能往往取决于构象集合和转变。在这里，我们同时解决基准范围和成功标准问题。我们引入 BILBY-PRO，一个从 PROSITE 关联实验结构中系统推导的结构保守功能基序基准，包含来自 174 个 PROSITE 基序模式条目的 220 个案例。评估六个近期支架生成模型揭示了在目标覆盖率和唯一解产出方面的不同模式：RFDiffusion 和 Proteina 解决更多目标，而 ESM3 在其解决的目标上产生更多唯一成功支架。我们进一步引入 BILBY-MD，一个基于参考的全原子分子动力学评估框架。应用于原始 MotifBench 基准中静态解决的设计，它将基序漂移、支架漂移、基序接触保持和基序二面角自由能景观与参考模拟进行比较。在 55 个静态解决的模型-问题对中，31 个满足我们的 MD 支持标准，仅 8 个通过所有检查。紧凑、自包含的基序通常得到 MD 支持，而界面样或上下文依赖的基序更频繁失败。因此，静态重折叠成功提供了局部基序恢复的有用证据，但并未确立完整支架的动力学保真度。BILBY 突出了基序支架评估的三个互补轴：目标覆盖率、唯一解产出和 MD 支持的动力学保真度。

items.title_en: LLM-Assisted Label Noise Correction for EEG-Based Sleep Stage Classification
items.title_zh: LLM 辅助的标签噪声校正用于基于 EEG 的睡眠分期分类
items.abstract_en: Automatic sleep stage classification from electroencephalography (EEG) signals is a critical task in clinical sleep medicine. While deep learning models have shown promising results in this domain, their performance is fundamentally constrained by the quality of training labels, which human experts manually annotate and that are subject to inter-rater disagreement and systematic labeling errors. In this paper, we propose a novel LLM-assisted label-noise filtering pipeline that operates exclusively during training to identify and remove unreliable sleep-stage annotations before retraining the classifier. Specifically, TinySleepNet is first trained on the original dataset to extract per-epoch SoftMax confidence scores, then low-confidence epochs are submitted to LLaMA 3.1 along with their EEG spectral features and surrounding sequence context. The LLM evaluates each epoch against AASM sleep-scoring guidelines and assigns a verdict of RELIABLE or SUSPICIOUS. Suspicious epochs are removed from the training set, and TinySleepNet is retrained on the cleaned data. Evaluated on the Sleep-EDF Expanded dataset using 20-fold cross-validation, our method improves overall accuracy from 81.8% to 84.6% and Macro F1-score from 75.6% to 77.4%, with particularly notable gains in REM detection. Crucially, because the LLM operates only during training, the lightweight TinySleepNet architecture (1.3M parameters) is preserved at inference, making the proposed pipeline suitable for real-time, wearable sleep monitoring applications.
items.abstract_zh: 基于脑电图（EEG）信号的自动睡眠分期分类是临床睡眠医学中的关键任务。尽管深度学习模型在该领域显示出有希望的结果，但其性能从根本上受限于训练标签的质量，这些标签由人类专家手动标注，并且受到评分者间分歧和系统性标注错误的影响。在本文中，我们提出一种新颖的 LLM 辅助标签噪声过滤流程，该流程仅在训练期间运行，以在重新训练分类器之前识别并移除不可靠的睡眠分期标注。具体而言，首先在原始数据集上训练 TinySleepNet 以提取每个 epoch 的 SoftMax 置信度分数，然后将低置信度 epoch 连同其 EEG 频谱特征和周围序列上下文提交给 LLaMA 3.1。LLM 根据 AASM 睡眠评分指南评估每个 epoch，并给出 RELIABLE 或 SUSPICIOUS 的判定。可疑 epoch 从训练集中移除，并在清洗后的数据上重新训练 TinySleepNet。在 Sleep-EDF Expanded 数据集上使用 20 折交叉验证评估，我们的方法将总体准确率从 81.8% 提高到 84.6%，宏 F1 分数从 75.6% 提高到 77.4%，在 REM 检测方面提升尤为显著。关键在于，由于 LLM 仅在训练期间运行，轻量级 TinySleepNet 架构（130 万参数）在推理时得以保留，使所提流程适用于实时可穿戴睡眠监测应用。

items.title_en: H-BRICK: Hierarchical Boundary Reachability Index with Compressed Kleene Closure for Directed Grid Graphs
items.title_zh: H-BRICK：用于有向网格图的带压缩 Kleene 闭包的分层边界可达性索引
items.abstract_en: Repeated directed reachability queries arise in online path planning, task-agent allocation, and swarm control on static grid maps, where reachability is asymmetric and full transitive closure is storage-prohibitive. We introduce H-BRICK, a Hierarchical Boundary Reachability Index with Compressed Kleene closure for exact cell-to-cell queries on directed grid graphs. H-BRICK partitions the graph into tiles, computes a local Boolean Kleene closure within each tile, and projects it onto the tile's boundary ports. The resulting directed port-to-port summaries are then composed recursively across shared interfaces up to a single root covering the graph. We prove algebraically that the construction is exact: in the Boolean Kleene algebra of binary relations, every composed summary equals the boundary projection of the regional reflexive transitive closure, and every cell-to-cell query agrees with reachability in the original graph. Experiments on directed grid graphs across diverse map topologies compare H-BRICK against directed search and component-based baselines, and compare its storage requirements against full transitive closure. A batched reachability evaluation further demonstrates that sharing endpoint lifts across many-source/many-target queries amortizes hierarchical traversal and, at k=64, yields a 5.0x-22.9x throughput improvement over the scalar query loop. The results show that hierarchical boundary compression is most advantageous in query-intensive spatial graphs where online search traverses large reachable regions and the hierarchy maintains compact boundary interfaces.
items.abstract_zh: 重复的有向可达性查询出现在静态网格图上的在线路径规划、任务-智能体分配和群控制中，其中可达性是不对称的，并且完整传递闭包在存储上不可行。我们引入 H-BRICK，一种用于有向网格图上精确单元到单元查询的带压缩 Kleene 闭包的分层边界可达性索引。H-BRICK 将图划分为瓦片，在每个瓦片内计算局部布尔 Kleene 闭包，并将其投影到瓦片的边界端口上。然后，所得的有向端口到端口摘要通过共享接口递归组合，直至覆盖整个图的单一根。我们从代数上证明该构造是精确的：在二元关系的布尔 Kleene 代数中，每个组合摘要等于区域自反传递闭包的边界投影，并且每个单元到单元查询与原始图中的可达性一致。在不同地图拓扑的有向网格图上的实验将 H-BRICK 与有向搜索和基于组件的基线进行比较，并将其存储需求与完整传递闭包进行比较。批量可达性评估进一步表明，在多源/多目标查询之间共享端点提升可以摊销分层遍历，并且在 k=64 时，相比标量查询循环，吞吐量提高 5.0 倍至 22.9 倍。结果表明，分层边界压缩在查询密集型空间图中最为有利，其中在线搜索遍历大的可达区域，并且层次结构保持紧凑的边界接口。
